data.description: Discover three of Rome’s top ancient sites—the Colosseum, the Roman Forum and the ruins of Palatine Hill—on a private tour. Don’t worry about navigating the city, entry fees, or waiting in line as your personal local guide shares fascinating stories and insights on the history of Eternal City to bring ancient Rome to life.

data.name: Rome Bag Storage Luggage Storage (Luggage Storage Colosseum)
data.description:
Leave your luggage in our luggage room!

The duration of the locker rental service is easily extended in the store: if your rental will last more than 6 hours, you will simply have to pay the hourly difference on your return.

We have lockers of 3 different sizes that adapt to all needs:

- Large: contains one hold baggage or two trolleys

- Medium: holds up to two trolleys

- Small: contains one or two backpacks.

Automated luggage storage offering 3 different sizes of Locker, a 3-minute walk from the Coliseum.

Whether you arrive at the airport early in the morning and check in early in the afternoon, or check out in the morning and have your return flight late at night, you can leave your luggage in the storage room to fully enjoy the city without your heavy suitcases.

data.name: Rome Monti City Center Street Food Tour
data.description: Do something a little different for lunch or dinner with this street food tour around Rome’s Monti neighborhood. Bring your appetite as your guide takes you to local food hotspots. Enjoy tasting authentic pizza, pasta, and biscotti as you pick up restaurant recommendations along the way. Perfect for getting a taste of what Rome has to offer.

data.name: Rome: Colosseum, Roman Forum, Palatine Hill Guided Tour
data.description: Immerse yourself in the history of Rome—and discover three top attractions, all in a single excursion—on this in-depth tour. With your guide in the lead, head on a journey through time to explore each site's captivating past: You'll see the world wonder that is the Colosseum, discover the Roman Forum, and visit Palatine Hill. As you go, your guide will bring the landmarks' stories alive for a transportive experience.

data.name: Rome: Rione Parione Private Walking Food Tour
data.description: We have combined the best local bites in a 3 hour private walkin food tour in the IV Rione of Rome , Parione. All best tasting have already been sorted out for you and your friends and are of course covered in the price . Along the walk you will visit 2 of the most beautiful Piazze of the city , Navona and Campo de Fiori plus discover how this borough became a well know artisans-home area!.So you ll get to know all historic and cultural insight while savor on some magnificent food. Walkin Food your Experience!

data.name: Colosseum, Palatine Hill, Forum Tour with Small-Group Upgrade
data.description: Tick off three of Rome’s most popular ancient sites with this short-but-sweet tour of the Colosseum, Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill. Enrich your visit with stories and insights from your guide as you explore each millennia-old landmark, all in under three hours. See where gladiators fought epic battles, where senators advised the emperor, and where everyday Romans went about their lives.

data.name: Vatican Museums and St. Peter's Private Skip-the-Line Tour
data.description: Discover the highlights of one of the world's greatest art collections on this private tour of the Vatican Museums. After skipping the ticket line, see the Raphael Rooms, Sistine Chapel, and more, plus visit St. Peter's Basilica. You can avoid having to navigate this large and usually crowded venue by yourself and gain more insights to the masterpieces you're seeing with commentary from an art historian guide.

data.name: Rome: Colosseum Self-Guided Entry + Sunset Walking Tour Outside
data.description:
Experience the Colosseum the smart way — flexible, family-friendly, and crafted for today’s traveler.

Choose hosted self-guided entry between 3:00 PM and 5:00 PM (based on availability), followed by our signature 6:30 PM small-group storytelling walk outside the Colosseum. As the sun sets and crowds fade, your expert local guide brings ancient Rome to life through powerful stories and sweeping views.

Prefer just the evening walk? Book our "Evening Walking Tour Only – 6:30 PM" option for a stress-free, heat-free experience. Add our "Photo & Video Souvenir Pack" to capture your golden-hour memories, with a local photographer on-site from 6:00 PM.

Perfect for families, cruises, and Viator TAP partners. We blend flexibility, efficiency, and real connection — no pressure, no confusion. That’s the Pointours Promise.

data.name: Pienza and Montepulciano Private Day Trip from Rome
data.description: The UNESCO-listed Val d’Orcia is one of the most beautiful corners of Tuscany, but exploring these rural hills with public transport or a rental car is stressful. With this private day trip, leave the driving to a professional and focus on the views, not the road. Avoid the delays of the bus and train and cover both Pienza and Montepulciano in one day, plus opt to stop for a wine tasting at a local cellar (own expense).

data.name: Rome Private Food Walking Tour with 6 or 10 Tastings
data.description:
Take a unique look at Rome's culinary offerings on a private food tour focused on specific Roman dishes.

Join a local foodie on a tour through Rome to sample six or 10 tastings (depending on the option chosen at checkout) of the city's best dishes, including buffalo mozzarella and authentic Italian gelato.

Stop at several places throughout the tour to learn about and then sample one dish. Enjoy the sights of the city in between stops with provided historical context from your host.

data.name: Skip the Line : Ticket to the Vatican Museum & sistine chapel,
data.description: The Vatican Museums boast an extraordinary collection of art and historical treasures, highlighted by the world-renowned Sistine Chapel. This impressive institution houses an extensive array of masterpieces by illustrious artists such as Michelangelo, Raphael, and Leonardo da Vinci. The Sistine Chapel, with its breathtaking frescoes, is the crown jewel of the museum complex. Visitors are spellbound by Michelangelo's iconic ceiling and "The Last Judgment" fresco. The Vatican Museums offer a captivating journey through art, history, and culture, providing a profound glimpse into the rich legacy of the Vatican City. A visit to the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel guarantees an unparalleled experience filled with artistic marvels and historical significance.

data.name: House of Caesar Augustus and the Emperor's Palace Tour in Rome
data.description: Explore the House of Caesar Augustus and the Emperor’s Palace with an expert archaeologist on a tour that reveals ancient Rome’s imperial past. Visit the Palatine Museum and the richly decorated Houses of Augustus and Livia, featuring original mosaics and sculptures. Walk through the ruins of the Emperor’s Palace and along ancient Roman roads, with included access to the Roman Forum and the Arches of Constantine and Titus.

data.name: Private Rome in a Day Tour with Colosseum & Sistine Chapel
data.description: If you’ve got limited time in Rome, make the most of it by booking this private highlights tour. Your guide will map out an itinerary that encompasses major must-sees including the Colosseum, the Roman Forum, and the Vatican Museums, with admission included. Along the way, your guide helps illuminate Roman history and culture, and highlight things that may otherwise go unnoticed.

data.name: Colosseum Golden Hour Guided Tour with Skip-The-Lines Ticket
data.description: Maximize your short time in Rome, with a visit to the Colosseum and enjoy comfort, convenience, and and unforgettable experience. Skip the long lines with fast-track entry and immerse yourself in the fascinating history of this ancient wonder with the help of an expert guide. Discover the stories behind its grandeur, learn about its significance in Roman culture, and marvel at its architectural brilliance. This experience offers history, convenience, and awe all in one.

data.name: Rome Colosseum Restricted Areas and Dungeons Group Tour
data.description: Access corners of the Colosseum most tourists miss with this exclusive small-group tour that includes the underground dungeons and other restricted areas. Join your guide to explore the corridors and cells that once held gladiators and wild animals, plus stand on the arena floor. Learn about the history and design of the ancient stadium before moving on to admire the ancient temples and squares in the Forum.

data.name: Rome Private Vespa Tour with Driver and Optional Pickup
data.description: Enjoy the freedom of riding a Vespa in Rome without the responsibility of driving it on this private tour. Your driver will do all the navigating while you take in the city's sights. See major attractions such as the Colosseum and visit several different districts in Rome with an Italian speaker who can help you navigate any language barriers.

data.name: Colosseum Underground Tour With Arena Floor: Vip Experience
data.description: Experience the Colosseum like never before with a VIP tour designed for time-pressed travelers and first-time visitors to Rome. Choose from multiple convenient start times and head straight inside to areas normally off-limits to the general public—including the atmospheric underground chambers. Hear spine-tingling stories of gladiators, wild animals, and the crowds who once filled the seats, as your guide brings the Colosseum’s bloody past vividly to life.

data.name: Rome Vatican Museums and Colosseum Walking Tour
data.description: With this full-day tour, save time by visiting Rome’s most legendary attractions in one day: the Colosseum and the Vatican. After meeting your guide and group, start your day with a comprehensive tour of the Vatican, visiting the museums, the Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter's Basilica. Then, after a short break for lunch (own expense), tour the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and the Roman Forum.

data.name: Vespa Tour - The Essence of Rome
data.description: Choose from morning or afternoon departure time for this comprehensive tour of Rome on a scooter. Renting a Vespa means you'll blend in with the locals as you explore highlights such as the Pantheon, Campo de' Fiori, Piazza di Spagna, and other sites. Customize your experience by choosing to ride your own scooter or traveling with a partner.

data.name: Day Trip from Rome to Pompeii
data.description: Your Personal expert Driver will pick you up at 7:30 AM in Rome to start an incredible adventure from Rome to Pompeii. The ancient town was covered by ashes of the Mount Vesuvius eruption in 79 A.C. and has been captivating archaeologists from all over the world, since the excavations began. Walking through the extensive ruins of Pompeii with your personal tour guide for 2 hours, you’ll see Mount Vesuvius from a distance. After a nice lunch in a typical trattoria in Pompeii your driver will take you back to Rome.

data.name: Full Day by Golf Cart with Lunch Pizza and Gelato and Wine
data.description:
Discover Rome in a fun and unforgettable way with full-day 6-hour tour!

Cruise around the city in a stylish golf cart, exploring iconic landmarks at your own pace.

Enjoy authentic Italian gelato as you soak in the vibrant atmosphere, and indulge in delicious Roman pizza for a true taste of Italy.

Perfect for friends, families, or solo travelers, this experience combines comfort, fun, and culture in one fantastic day. Don’t miss the chance to create unforgettable memories and see Rome like never before!

data.name: Rome Jubilee Small-Group Early Christianity Tour
data.description: Make the most of your time in Rome during the 2025 Jubilee with a tour that focuses specifically on early Christianity. Visit historic basilicas with a guide, including the Arcibasilica di San Giovanni in Laterano, whose Holy Doors are only opened during Jubilee years. As an added bonus, sample maritozzi, sweet buns filled with cream, at celebrated Roman bakery Panella.

data.name: Rome Small-Group Vespa Tour With Self-Drive, Private Options
data.description: Explore Rome like a local on an Italian Vespa scooter with this small-group tour that makes the journey just as fun as the destination. Traveling by scooter means you’ll be able to wind in and out of traffic, and won’t have to worry about parking a bulky vehicle on Rome’s winding streets. Plus, you can choose to self-drive or opt to join the tour as a passenger of a Vespa driven by a professional driver.

data.name: Colosseum & Roman Forum: Family-Friendly Private Half-Day Tour
data.description: Immerse yourself into Ancient Rome and travel back to the time of Roman gladiators by exploring the Colosseum, also known as the Flavian Amphitheater and the Roman Forum, the scenario for public meetings, gatherings and shops, on this family-friendly half-day tour especially designed for young children and teens in mind. On your private tour, you will: Bring Ancient Rome to life on this child and family-friendly tour with your private guide; Learn of the famed Gladiators and their courageous fights at the Colosseum; Hear the stories of the first games ever held in the times of Emperor Titus; Find out how many spectators the amphitheatre could accommodate and who could be invited; Have a sweet treat on us and a short break to enjoy some gelato; Explore the Roman Forum considered the heart of Ancient Rome and the first open-air public meeting place; Discover what religiousceremonies and festivals were held there; Walk past the remains of numerous important buildings, built to honour men and roman gods. If any site in Rome will entertain your children, the Colosseum will! A symbol of Rome and of the Ancient Roman Empire, this building has been entertaining people for millennia! This is where the Emperor and the Roman people would come to watch the "games" ranging from gladiator fights to processions of exotic animals. After visiting the Colosseum (time-entrance tickets included), you will see the Arch of Constantine, built to commemorate Emperor Constantine the Great's victory over Maxentius in 312 AD. Your guide will regale you with tales of the Emperor and his army triumphantly marching into Rome! You will then head into the Roman Forum and walk on the Via Sacra (or "sacred way"), the main street of Ancient Rome. This was the "downtown" area of the city where Senators and people alike came to meet and trade, hear public speeches, vote in elections, trial criminals, host religious ceremonies... and more! You will even see the ruins of the Temple of Julius Caesar and his altar, where people still lay flowers today in commemoration of the famed Roman General! Depending on the day and your preference, you will enjoy a quick stop for a delicious Italian Gelato either halfway through the tour for a sweet treat break or at the end of the tour. This shorter tour is ideal for families with young children and does not include a visit to Palatine Hill.  Please note: During the Jubilee Year, Rome is expected to experience increased visitor numbers and heightened security measures. While we strive to provide a seamless experience, some attractions may face last-minute closures without prior notice, longer-than-usual wait times, or time restrictions on visits inside certain attractions due to crowd control policies.In such cases, your guide will expertly adapt the itinerary to ensure the best possible experience, using their local knowledge to navigate any challenges. We appreciate your understanding and patience as we work to make your visit to Rome unforgettable despite these unique circumstances.

data.name: Colosseum Private Guided Tour
data.description:
Take a journey through one of the true wonders of the world!

Also known as the Flavian Amphitheatre, the Colosseum is one of the most important monuments in the world, famous in Roman times for the crude fights between gladiators and for the exciting imperial events.

The Palatine Hill is one of the oldest areas of Rome where currently there are the ruins of the temples and palaces of the Roman emperors who lived there.

The Roman Forum was the place where the life of the city took place: politics, justice, commerce, social life and the worship of the gods, that is, the heart of the city of RomeZarfati Do Amaral Tours is a leading Rome tour organization in the field of guided tours and cultural tourism.

We are a professional family-run agency, which has lived in the center of Rome for generations and it is our goal to make this city known and loved by all the people who come to visit us

data.name: Italian Wine and Food Golf Cart Tour in Rome
data.description:
Experience Rome like a VIP with our Golf Cart Food Tour – the perfect way to explore the city’s culinary delights while sightseeing in style.

Along the way, we'll visit Trastevere and the breathtaking Gianicolo Hill Lookout Point. We'll head to another iconic neighborhood, Testaccio, in the comfortable electric cart. Here, you'll visit the famous market to taste the delights of Roman street food before comfortably heading towards Testaccio and concluding with an authentic gelato at a historic local bar.

data.name: Trastevere Private Food & Wine Tour with Expert Guide
data.description: Explore the Trastevere district of Rome on a food and wine tour that introduces you to local food, family businesses, cobbled lanes, and a market. With a guide, you'll have the chance to sample items such as pizza, pasta, cheese, and salami.

data.name: Rome: Sunset Cooking Class in the Jewish Ghetto
data.description: Meet your host in Rome city center and take a walk into the Jewish Ghetto, one of the oldest and liveliest areas of the Eternal city. Access a very special restaurant, located in a historic building with a unique view of the area. Learn more about the history and legends concerning the Jewish district and its unique food style. Prepare pasta or gnocchi with the help of an expert chef and other typical dishes according to season; during the wintertime, you’ll have the opportunity to learn how to peel artichokes to be cooked in the Jewish-style, a must of Rome's cuisine. During summertime cooking classes, you’ll learn how to prepare zucchini flowers or any other amazing fresh vegetable to make the original “fritto romano”. In the end, taste the amazingly baked "ciambelline al vino", famous crunchy donuts made with four simple ingredients.

data.name: Rome Off the Beaten Path Walking Tour
data.description:
This is more than just a history walk—it's a time-travel experience through Rome’s ancient grandeur and its lesser-known corners. An expert, English-speaking guides blend storytelling, archaeology, and local insight to bring ruins to life and uncover stories you won’t find in guidebooks.

You’ll explore not just the famous monuments, but also the quiet places where real Roman life—past and present—intersect. Perfect for curious travelers who crave authenticity, depth, and discovery in just 90 minutes.

data.name: Rome Small-Group Pasta Cooking Class with Wine
data.description: In Rome, the ultimate souvenir isn't one you can pack—it's learning how to make fresh Italian pasta. You'll do just that during this small-group fettuccine workshop, right on beautiful Piazza Navona. Get hands-on instruction from a chef as you master the art of pasta making, and at the workshop's end, you'll get time to feast on your creations.

data.name: Rome Private Driving Tour Sightseeing of the Eternal city
data.description:
Get the comfort and flexibility by choosing this Rome Driving Private Tour.

You’ll have at your full disposal for 7 hours a Luxury Mercedes Minivan and and your Driverguide.

You will be able to see every corner of Rome, even the one you never thought would have been there.

This tour is dedicated to all the one have No time to spend in Rome and would like to see the most beautiful city in the world.

data.name: Rome: Private Sightseeing Photoshoot With Local Guide
data.description: Make sure the memories from your Rome vacation last a lifetime with this private, family-friendly photography experience around the heart of the city. Tick iconic Roman attractions off your sightseeing bucket list—like the Colosseum and the Roman Forum—and check out hidden gems you probably would have missed without the help of your guide, who’ll snap flattering pics of you along the way.

data.name: Palazzo Doria Pamphilj Private Guided
data.description: Discover the magnificent Palazzo Doria Pamphilj on a private guided tour featuring works by Caravaggio, Raphael, Titian, and more, set amidst opulent ballrooms, luxurious chandeliers, and lavish galleries that showcase the grandeur of the palace. As you explore, learn about the masterpieces, the talented artists behind them, and the influential Doria Pamphilj family whose history and legacy are intertwined with the art and architecture of this exquisite residence.

data.name: Chocolate Tasting Experience in Rome Pantheon
data.description: Indulge in the world of Venchi, the renowned Italian chocolatier with this exclusive luxury experience. Every aspect is a celebration of opulence, taste, and the artistry of chocolate-making.Begin your journey in the shop located in the charming historic centre of Rome, where you'll be captivated by a storytelling session that unravels the rich history and dedication to crafting exceptional chocolates of this esteemed brand. The next stage invites you to delve into the fascinating tale of the featured product, promising an unparalleled and mouth-wateringly delightful journey. As you advance further, relish a curated selection of six exquisite chocolates during a guided tasting session. This allows you to discover the subtle flavours and craftsmanship behind each creation.To make the experience even more memorable, you'll receive a 10% discount on additional purchases. This enables you to take home boxes of beautifully crafted chocolates to share or savour at your own pace. And don’t forget to bring home a delightful selection of chocolates for your sweet indulgences.

data.name: Rome by Night Walking Tour with Trevi Fountain and Colosseum
data.description:
Begin your evening adventure by meeting your guide just as Rome’s lights begin to glow. Set out on foot to discover why this city is celebrated as one of the world’s most stunning destinations after dark.

First, pause at the Pantheon, where the moonlit facade offers a photo-worthy scene. Then continue to the famed Trevi Fountain—an icon of Rome’s Baroque charm. If you like, drop a coin in for good luck (a longstanding local custom).

Next, ascend Capitoline Hill for a glimpse of the Roman Forum below, a sprawling testament to the grandeur of the ancient Empire. Finally, make your way to the Colosseum. Once alive with cheering crowds and daring gladiators, it now stands as a silent monument to Rome’s storied past. Explore its imposing exterior, learning intriguing facts and tales from your guide about this colossal amphitheater’s rich history.

data.name: Italian Handmade Pasta Cooking Masterclass With Chef
data.description: You can eat pasta to your heart’s content while in Rome, but what happens after the vacation ends? Learn how to recreate classic Roman pasta dishes like cacio e pepe or amatriciana during this small-group cooking class. Get hands-on instruction within the home of an Italian nonna in an intimate group, with vegetarian options available. After the course, sit down to enjoy your freshly prepared meal.

data.name: Exclusive Colosseum Tour with Top-Rated Guide
data.description: Experience the grandeur of Rome's Colosseum in just 75 minutes with this express tour, designed to maximize your time without compromising on the sights. Join a knowledgeable guide and a small group to gain exclusive entry, diving straight into the history of this iconic amphitheater, renowned for its gladiatorial battles and architectural brilliance. Perfect for those looking to tick off a must-see attraction without a lengthy commitment!

data.name: Rome Gelato Making Class And Tasting With Local Artisan
data.description: Learn to create creamy, authentic Italian gelato in this hands-on Rome masterclass guided by a local artisan. Craft your own delicious gelato using fresh ingredients, explore traditional churning techniques, and enjoy your creation paired with wine or coffee for the sweetest experience in the Eternal City.

data.name: Small-Group Rome Food Tour in Trastevere
data.description: In a city like Rome where countless restaurants and bars exist, it’s not so easy to find the best places to eat. So, avoid the tourist traps, and head out with a guide instead to find eateries that you’ll want to revisit. You’ll explore Trastevere, a lively pocket of Rome, on a fun small-group tour that includes samples of seasonal dishes, pizza, pasta, and even a drink, too.

data.name: Valentine' Day Opera Serenades in Palazzo Doria Pamphilj with traditional roman dinner
data.description: Explore on Valentine' Day the concealed wonders within the Secret Apartment of Princess Doria Pamphilj, a treasury of art and history, exclusively unveiled for a privileged few. This is an evening of simultaneous pleasures, listening, and tasting. After your Opera Concert, we offer you the chance to discover even more flavors of Rome with a special dinner. The cosy Restaurant 'Il piccolo Vicolo' with the dedication to Roman cuisine has joined with us to give you a full sensory experience by sampling the finest food and wine that Rome has to offer. Opera and food together bring about a one of a kind experience. Immerse yourself in a serenade accompanied by world-class voices resonating through rooms steeped in nobility and adorned with masterpieces. Every note weaves into the historical tapestry of this space, where classical furnishings and opulent artworks collectively echo a splendid era long past. Within the very halls that the Doria Pamphilj family has graced for centuries, partake in a concert that pays homage to this legacy. Each carefully chosen piece mirrors the architectural and artistic marvels enveloping you, delivering an educational and enchanting performance. Our curated repertoire guides guests on an auditory journey through Italy’s musical heritage, resonating with the essence of the nation's rich history. Led by a sublime soprano, whose voice captivates like the narratives within each aria, the performance is enhanced by the melodic whispers of a transverse flute and the resonant strumming of a baroque guitar. The theorbo's deep, sonorous plucks add a layer of baroque richness, crafting a multi-sensory tribute to Italy’s musical masters. With exclusivity as our signature, attendance is intentionally limited, fostering a personal connection to both the music and the majestic surroundings. Secure your tickets now and be among the select few to revel in opera within the private chambers of Princess Doria Pamphilj. It transcends mere performance it becomes a cherished memory of your Roman holiday, an extraordinary event beyond the ordinary. data.name: Rome Colosseum and San Clemente Basilica Small-Group Tour
data.description: See a unique view of Rome's Colosseum and San Clemente Basilica on this small-group tour. Start your adventure at the Roman Forum, once the heart of public life, and explore centuries of history. Stroll through Palatine Hill, the legendary birthplace of Rome, known for its ancient ruins and imperial palaces. Then, step inside the Colosseum, the world’s largest and most iconic amphitheater, before concluding at Basilica of San Clemente, with centuries of history beneath its ancient walls.

data.name: Rome by Night: Drinks and Nibbles Small-Group Golf Cart Tour
data.description: Get a taste of Roman nightlife without the hassle of researching where to go on this sociable small-group night tour featuring fabulous views, fine wines, and delicious Roman nibbles. Start with a glass of prosecco at a viewpoint on Janiculum Hill; enjoy an aperitivo with cured meats and cheeses in Trastevere; pair local wines with crispy artichokes in a wine bar; then sip cocktails with tiramisu.

data.name: Rome Trastevere Small-Group Walking Tour with Food Tastings
data.description: See a lesser-known side of Rome on this small-group walking tour of Trastevere. With a local guide leading the way, uncover hidden courtyards, Renaissance villas, and ancient streets full of character and history. Stroll past landmarks such as the Villa Farnesina and Tiber Island and enjoy tastings from a selection of foodie spots loved by the locals.

data.name: Rome Underground Catacombs and Crypt Guided Tour
data.description: Let an expert guide help you unearth the mysteries of Rome's underground on this tour of the catacombs in Domitila. Hear intriguing tales of ancient Christian practices and view the artworks. Delve into the history, unveiling crypts adorned with both pagan and Christian symbols. Prepare to be amazed by the tomb of Diogenes, the ingenious grave digger responsible for the mesmerizing labyrinth of graves.

data.name: Skip the line Colosseum and Ancient Rome Small Group Walking Tour
data.description: Colosseum, Palatine Hill and Roman Forum skip the line sharing tour. Have fun discovering Roman history and Gladiator combats! Visit the Colosseum with an enthusiastic guide who will reveal many stories and anecdotes on Roman emperors and Senators. You will visit the Colosseum, go to the Palatine Hill to see the ruins of the Palace of the emperor Domitian,see the panoramic view of the Circus Maximus and then walk to the Roman Forum where triumphal Arches and temples are still standing as a symbol of the power of Ancient Rome. Like a time machine you will go back to Roman times! this tour includes skip the line tickets and a friendly storytelling guide who will bring Roman life back to life!

data.name: Private Walking Tour of Vatican Museums and Colosseum
data.description: Vatican City and Colosseum in one day. We have created a custom-tailored tour for the ones who want to discover more deeply two memorable landmarks, custodians par excellence of the ancient history of Italy and of the whole world. With this exclusive tour you will discover all the secrets and anecdotes concealed in the ancestral stones and works of art enshrined inside these amazing attractions.Our official tour guide will meet you just outside the colosseum Individual entrance at 8:15 AM. He/She will have a sign board with your last name printed on it. You will find yourself in front of the largest amphitheater ever built, considered one of the greatest works of architecture and engineering. data.name: Catacombs of Saint Callixtus: Guided Tour
data.shortDescription: Tour some of Rome's most important ancient catacombs
data.description:
There are catacombs all over Rome. The Catacombs of St. Callixtus are some of the most important, as they mark the final resting place for many Christian martyrs and early popes.

On this guided tour, you'll explore the most intriguing sections of the enormous 3rd-century catacombs, where the remains of half a million Christians were entombed. Find out the meaning behind mysterious symbols etched into stone, and walk around ancient crypts. This 40-minute tour is a great way to introduce yourself to the Eternal City's subterranean story and religious timeline.

data.name: Jewish Quarter: Jewish Museum of Rome + Tempio Maggiore
data.shortDescription: Discover a Jewish community's ancient tale
data.description:
Step into the Jewish Museum of Rome to explore the vibrant tapestry of Jewish life in Rome, a tale that began in the 2nd century BC.

The museum offers a seamless window into a community that has flourished in Rome for over two millennia, standing as a testament to one of the oldest Jewish communities. 

The exhibits, mostly from the Ghetto period (1555-1870), proudly reside in the magnificent Palazzo delle Cinque Scole, also known as the Palace of the Five Synagogues.

The museum also has an expansive collection of liturgical furnishings, manuscripts, incunabula, historical documents, registers, and marble works.

data.name: Catacombs and Capuchin Crypt Guided Tour with Transfer
data.description: Get ready to have your assumptions about Rome turned upside down on this incredibly unique journey of discovery. The itinerary includes some of the most uncommon, mysterious and outlandish sites the Eternal City has to offer. After a guided tour of the Catacombs of Domitilla, visit the Capuchin Crypt and learn about the friars' simple lifestyle, closeness to the poor and spirit of fraternity.Start your experience by taking a panoramic bus to reach the Catacombs of Domitilla. Then embark on a fascinating underground tour of the catacombs, taking you into the unusual history of Rome. Learn how this extensive network of underground tunnels, dating back almost 2,000 years to the 2nd century AD, was once a burial ground and a place of worship for the early Christians in Rome.After the guided tour, you'll visit the famous Capuchin Crypt in Via Veneto on your own with an audio guide. Learn about the crypt and the remains of the approximately 4,000 friars decorating the floor-to-ceiling designs, lending it the macabre nickname of "the Bone Chapel". Explore the museum to discover the history of the religious order from its origins in the 16th century to the present day.

It came to dominate Western Europe and the entire area surrounding the Mediterranean Sea through conquest and assimilation, but eventually succumbed to barbarian invasions in the 5th century, marking the decline of the Roman Empire and the beginning of the Middle Ages.

data.name: Ghosts of Rome: Secrets and Mysteries Night Tour
data.description: As the sun sets over Rome a new city comes to light – a city of legends and mystery, where thousands of years have left a story behind every stone. Having survived the Middle Ages and the Inquisition, the stories Rome has to tell are far from the average bedtime tale: fraught with murder, execution and haunting. Join us on a night-time adventure that leaves no stone unturned, telling you the unseen history behind the stunning buildings of central Rome. You’ll see the house of the most notorious (and empathetic) murderer ever to operate in the Eternal City and visit the bridge that, as the legend has it, is haunted by the ghost of a female Pope. Your guide will take you back in time to a city that burned heretics like roast pigs and cured its crime problems by hanging pictures of the Virgin Mary on every corner. Our original Rome night tours show you a side of the Eternal City far away from the grandeur of the Renaissance and the high fashion of today. For an experience of Rome you won’t forget, and a chance to dig a little deeper into the long and twisted history of the Eternal City, join us on our original ghosts and legends storytelling tour.

data.name: Rome: Private Pizza and Gelato Making Class in Rome
data.description: Enjoy a totally immersive, interactive, and delicious private cooking class where you’ll make your own Roman-style pizza and delicious Italian gelato ice cream with a local Italian chef who speaks perfect English. In your private cooking class you will: -Enjoy the personalised and expert attention of your chef-instructor!Feel welcome and at home with a glass of prosecco and classic Italian snacks to keep you going, as your private chef introduces the class to you! Hear about Roman pizza - how it’s made, how its thin crust differs from thick crust Neapolitan pizzas. Learn the all-important answer to the question: what’s the difference between gelato and ice cream? As you learn how to make it. See how to make a traditional Roman pizza, gather your ingredients, watch your professional chef demonstrate how to knead the pizza dough expertly – and have to go yourself! Decorate! Once your dough is ready, it’s time to get kneading again and roll it out so it’s nicely flattened, then choose from a variety of delicious, fresh Roman ingredients laid out for you. Eat and enjoy your very own handmade Roman pizza and the dolce homemade gelato after!Note: Gluten-free and vegetarian options are available.  Enjoy a fantastic foodie experience in Rome on this private pizza and gelato ice cream making class with a professional English-speaking Roman chef. Great fun for couples, friends and families, you’ll discover the secrets behind classic Roman cuisine: Roman pizza and gelato.  Your private chef instructor will welcome you to the class with a glass of prosecco (or soft drink if you prefer) and a variety of delicious Roman-style snacks and antipasti, from crisps to olives, cheeses and meats.  You’ll then be shown all the different ingredients that you’ll be using as you learn all about the history of pizza making and gelato ice cream in Rome. Then it’s time to get stuck in! First, make the gelato – and learn the differences between Italian gelato and ice cream. As the gelato sets, it’s time to move on to the pizza.  You’ll learn the art of kneading the pizza dough and flattening it out. You’ll have a huge variety of ingredients to choose from for the all-important toppings before cooking it in a traditional wood-fired pizza oven. Decide will it be Bianca or Rosso (with or without tomato sauce)? Will you use cured or cooked ham? Mushrooms? Olives? Which cheeses? The choice is yours! When you’re happy with the look of your pizza, take a specially made shovel and put it into a traditional, very hot wood-fired oven for just 1-2 minutes. The only thing left to do… is to tuck in and enjoy your pizza and gelato – Bon Appetito!

Slip on your audio guide and enter the eerie Bone Chapel, adorned with the remains of 4,000 Capuchin monks, then explore the catacombs once used by early Christians for clandestine worship.

Next, climb aboard an air-conditioned bus and journey to the Catacombs of Domitilla. Descend into this ancient underground cemetery to see frescoes, intriguing iconography, burial sites, and early Christian chapels, all brought to life by your historian guide.

Back on the surface, travel to Basilica San Nicola in Carcere, a historic underground church displaying frescoes and featuring the Chapel of Our Lady of Carmel, a captivating finale to your Crypts and Catacombs experience. Your tour concludes with drop-off at Piazza Barberini or Viale del Monte Oppio, depending on the day’s schedule.

data.name: Florence in one day: Uffizi Gallery guided tour and city tour
data.description: You will leave the centre of Rome in the early morning to start this advanture in the centre of Tuscany. In Florence, explore the birthplace of the Italian Renaissance. Walk along the medieval streets and admire some of the masterpieces of Italian architecture, including Brunelleschi's Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore.  You can't leave Florence without visiting one of the most famous art galleries in the world. Here you can admire numerous works of art by Botticelli, Michelangelo, Leonardo da Vinci, Raffaello, Giotto, Cimabue, Masaccio and many others. Among the precious exhibition halls of the Gallery, the most renowned one contains the refined works of Botticelli, amongst which the absolute masterpieces: "Primavera" and "Birth of Venus". The latter painting, the icon of the museum, represents the allegory of the birth of the goddess emerging from the sea foam and symbolizes the ideal of beauty as an expression of purity and spiritual quality, typical of the Renaissance Neoplatonic aesthetics. These guided tours will let you admire the most important museum of Florence: the Uffizi Gallery. The Museum is in the top floor of the building realized by Giorgio Vasari to house the administrative offices of the Tuscan State. The foundation of the Gallery has been desired by the Grand-duke Francesco I, during the years the collection has been enriched by the members of the Medici family, who were great lovers of paintings, sculpture and works of art.

data.name: Private Transfer from Civitavecchia Port to Hotel in Rome - Tour Option Available
data.description: Travel in style and comfort between Fiumicino Airport and your cruise ship terminal at Civitavecchia Port, and end your cruise stress free. The transportation provider has a proud history of punctuality, and the professional service is available 7 days a week to suit your needs. Pick-ups from Civitavecchia Port at the end of your cruise are direct from the pier where your cruise ship docks for transfer to the airport. At all meet and greet locations, the driver will be holding a sign with your name on it for ease of contact. Forget the stress of everyday life, and relax in the chauffeur-driven luxurious Mercedes. Before getting on board, enjoy a 3-hours tour of Rome. After your accomodation checkout, invest your time to make a ride to greet the city.

data.name: Shore Excursion to Rome: Full day tour from Civitavecchia Port with Lunch
data.description: Make the most of your stop at Civitavecchia by taking this full-day tour of Rome. See the Pantheon, the Coliseum, the Vatican and the Spanish Steps, among much more, and then sit down for a lavish Italian lunch. Our driver will pick you up at the dock of Civitavecchia port and you will reach Rome in about one hour, comfortably seated on our luxurious Mercedes. Your first stop will be St Peter’s Square, where the famous St Peter's Basilica is located, the world’s largest church and papal enclave inside Rome. Along the way our tour assistant will tell you some information about the history of the Square, the Basilica and the Vatican city, leading you through Rome’s ancient streets. Then our driver will take you to Piazza di Spagna, at the base of the Spanish Steps. The 135 steps linked the historic Bourbon Spanish Embassy with the Trinità dei Monti church at the summit. Designed by the architects Francesco de Sanctis and Alessandro Specchi, the Piazza di Spagna includes the interesting Fontana della Barcaccia, a Baroque fountain in the shape of a half-sunken ship. Continue to the Trevi district to see Rome’s most famous fountain. Set against the Palazzo Poli, the Trevi Fountain attracts many tourists every day who throw a coin in the water to ensure that one day they will return to Rome. Walk on to the Pantheon, dedicated to the Olympian gods and one of the best preserved monuments of Ancient Rome. Next, enter the heart of public life in the Roman Republic at the Imperial Forum. Learn how it developed over the centuries at the ruins of temples and markets that cover every period from the Roman Kingdom to the Middle Ages. The tour assistant will point out the main monuments, such as the Tabularium, Temple of Concord and Saturn, and the Basilica of Maxentius. Your last stop will be Coliseum, the greatest arena of the Roman Republic and the largest amphitheatre ever built. It takes its name from the nearby statue of Emperor Nero, and reveals more than 2,000 years of ancient history. At the end of your tour, you will be driven back to Civitavecchia port.

data.name: Rome to Amalfi or Vice Versa Private Transfer
data.description: Getting between Amalfi and Rome doesn’t have to be difficult. Save yourself the trouble of renting a car or the hassle of lugging suitcases around on trains by pre-booking a transfer just for your party of up to eight people. Service from Rome to Amalfi and from Amalfi is available.

data.name: Galleria Borghese Museum Tickets and Guided Tour in Italian
data.description: Visit the Galleria Borghese, one of the most famous art galleries in Rome, during a guided tour in Italian.This museum complex houses a large part of the Borghese Collection of paintings, sculptures and antiquities, initiated by Cardinal Scipione Borghese, nephew of Pope Paul V and avid collector of works by Caravaggio, who is well represented in the collection with the Boy with Basket of Fruit, Saint Jerome Writing, Sick Bacchus and others.Note of merit for the marvellous Salone: this, in fact, features a large fresco on the ceiling of the first room, the work of the Sicilian artist Mariano Rossi, who makes such good use of foreshortening that it seems almost three-dimensional. The fresco depicts Marcus Furius Camillus relieving the siege of the Capitol by the Gauls.The first room of the Salon is the Chamber of Ceres, with a marble vase depicting Oedipus and the Sphinx. The second room has a ceiling frescoed by Francesco Caccianiga with the Fall of Phaeton. The third room houses Bernini's Apollo and Daphne.It is precisely the works of Gian Lorenzo Bernini that make up a significant percentage of his production of secular sculpture, starting with early works such as the Goat Amalthea with Child Jupiter and Faun (1615) and Aeneas, Anchises and Ascanius (1618-19) up to the dynamic Rape of Proserpine (1621-22), Apollo and Daphne (1622-25) and David (1623), considered seminal works of Baroque sculpture.

data.name: Capuchin Crypt: Sacred Music in the Heart of Rome
data.description: Embark on a unique musical and art historical journey in a fascinating location: the Capuchin Crypt in Rome. Decorated with the bones of 4000 friars who died in the last centuries, the Crypt offers a mysterious and inspiring atmosphere. The musical program features Gregorian chant, as well as works of Roman Renaissance polyphony. The composers of the musical program are the Sistine Chapel Masters: Palestrina, Victoria, Carissimi, Pitoni, and Agazzari.

data.name: Rome's Borghese Gallery Private Tour with Skip-the-Line Ticket
data.description: See some of Rome’s finest artistic treasures on a private guided tour of the Borghese Gallery. The extensive collection can be overwhelming, but your guide will focus on the most important highlights. Learn more about works by Bernini, Caravaggio, Raphael, and others as you marvel at “Apollo & Daphne,” “Young Woman with a Unicorn,” and more. After your gallery tour, stroll through the mansion's beautiful gardens.

data.name: Rome Small-Group Assisi, Orvieto Tour
data.description: Take a break from the busy streets of Rome and visit the towns of Assisi and Orvieto on this small-group tour. Wander the streets of the Assisi, following in the footsteps of the famed native son, St. Francis, and stop in incredible Orvieto on the way back, one of the most striking hill towns you'll ever encounter.

data.name: Rome: Small-Group Golf-Cart Tour by Night, Prosecco and Gelato
data.description: Rome is one of the world’s most picturesque cities, but heat and crowds can turn even the best vacation into a tiring ordeal. Avoid both with this nighttime tour by golf cart, and experience Eternal City highlights like the Spanish Steps, Castel Sant’Angelo, and trendy Trastevere in the magical evening hours. Plus, a scoop of artisanal gelato and a glass of Prosecco are included as VIP perks.

data.name: Rome: Valmontone Outlet Shopping Private Tour
data.description: While the inner city has lots of stores for travelers looking to do a spot of shopping, outside of central Rome there are outlets that should delight shopaholics. On this full-day private tour, get picked up from your Rome accommodation and transported to the Valmontone Outlet, where there are more than 100 stores for you to discover.

data.name: Private Tour of Catholic Rome
data.description: Customize a private tour of Rome with a visit to its famous Catholic sites. Be chauffeured in the personalized comfort of a private Mercedes car or minivan and stop at monuments, piazzas and cathedrals. See the magnificent St Peter’s Basilica and explore others in the Eternal City such as the Basilica of Santa Maria del Popolo and the Holy Stairs at St John Lateran. Note: entrance fees and private guide are not included in the tour price.

data.name: Christian Rome Tour Semi-Private
data.description: Discover Rome and explore the sites that have made this city the center of Christianity. You can relive this ancient history walking through the Impressive Papal Basilicas, places where history, faith and art blend together through the lives of popes, saints and artists. You can visit the Basilica of St. Paul Outside the Walls, with its beautiful medieval cloister, then move on to the first Basilica in Rome, St. John Lateran, the place of the greements between the political power and the power of the Church. You will continue your journey in Catholicism at the Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore, the most important of the Roman churches dedicated to the Virgin Mary, with a lot of mosaics and decorations. You will conclude the tour admiring the elegance and the artistic and architectural majesty of St. Peter's Basilica and the masterpieces of Bernini and Michelangelo.

data.name: Rome: Roman Crypts and Catacombs Tour with Audio Guide
data.description:
Descend underneath a 14th-century Byzantine church to the site of a 4th-century basilica, and explore a 2nd-century cult shrine, then try to feel bygone spirits at 1st-century Roman street level.

Walk the corridors of the Christian catacombs, see frescoes, strange iconography surrounding burial places, and learn about the order of the Capuchin monks at the Capuchin Crypts, home to the remains of 4,000 priests propped up in the flesh (or, bones) ready to greet you.

Tours inside Capuchin Crypts run with audio guides, as per new rules imposed by the Capuchin Crypts.

data.name: Discover Pompeii: Excursion from Rome by high-speed train
data.description:
The excursion to Pompeii from Rome by high-speed train will take you on a fascinating journey into the past.

We will head south on a high-speed train to Naples, where our guide will take us to discover historic Pompeii, a Roman city frozen in time since 79 AD. After exploring this archaeological treasure, we will return to Naples to enjoy a guided tour of its charming streets, immersing ourselves in the magic of its history and culture.

An unforgettable experience for those who love history and archaeology!

data.name: Rome Private Walking Tour Plaza de Roma
data.description: The tour begins at Piazza del Popolo, where you’ll explore the Twin Churches and the Basilica of Santa Maria del Popolo, home to Caravaggio’s masterpieces. Discover the intriguing story of this “cursed painter” whose dramatic life and revolutionary art made headlines. Stroll down Via Margutta, an artistic haven known for its boutique workshops and serene charm. Then, visit Piazza di Spagna, famous for the Spanish Steps and Bernini’s Barcaccia Fountain. Walk along Via Condotti, Rome’s luxury shopping street. Enjoy a stop for a gelato or espresso at a historic café, experiencing la dolce vita. Pause at the Pantheon to marvel at its architectural majesty before discovering a hidden “talking statue” nearby, linked to Roman satire. Next, visit Piazza Navona, with Bernini’s Fountain of the Four Rivers and lively street performances. Explore a hidden passage to Campo de’ Fiori, where the tour ends. Learn about Giordano Bruno’s tragic story and soak in the square’s vibrant atmosphere.

data.name: Florence From Rome: Full-Day Tour by High-Speed Train
data.description: Make the most of your time in Italy with a full-day tour that whisks you from Rome to Florence via high-speed train—without you having to organize a thing. In Florence, a local guide is on-hand to lead you on a walking tour, offering personal insight on the city, plus, fascinating historical context. Learn about artistic geniuses such as Michelangelo, Dante, da Vinci, Machiavelli, and Galileo, plus, the Medici family. As you explore, pass by landmarks such as the Florence Duomo, Piazza della Signoria, and Ponte Vecchio. Finally, enjoy free time to explore independently, shop, or eat.

data.name: Rome Highlights By Electric Bicycle Private Tour
data.description: Take a tour of Rome's most remarkable sites in a top-of-the-line high quality E-Bike! Turn a long walking tour into a delightful adventure as we will quickly arrive to all principal treasures of the historical center of Rome by E-Bike, and pay a visit to legendary fountains and squares, Ancient Roman monuments and beautiful hidden corners of the Eternal City. Rome's Electric Bicycle tour is private, se we would always love to hear your thoughts and wishes as well and be happy to customise to tour depending on your interests! This tour is ideal for families with children. E-Bikes come in different sizes and we can provide a child seat if needed so join us and enjoy the ride while your personal guide leads you through heart of Rome.

data.name: Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore Tour
data.description: Although enlarged and redecorated, the basilica retains much of its original structure of the fifth century. In the years following the return of the papacy to Rome from Avignon, part of the church was used as a papal residence until the complete renovation of the Vatican palace. Admire its mosaics of the fifth century, a reliquary that is said to contain a piece of the crib that once held baby Jesus, an ancient icon of the Virgin Mary, the tomb of St. Jerome and the tomb of the artist Gian Lorenzo Bernini.There is also the Sistine Chapel in the Papal Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore, dedicated to Pope Sixtus V.

data.name: Florence: Full-Day Renaissance Tour from Rome
data.description:
Immerse yourself in Italian culture, art, and history with a day trip from Rome to Florence, the heart of the Renaissance. Board a high-speed train for a relaxing trip to this enchanting city.

The your begins with a guided walking tour through Florence's storied streets. See the magnificent Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, its iconic dome dominating the skyline with its grandeur and walk across the Ponte Vecchio, a symbol of medieval craftsmanship spanning the Arno River.

After the guided exploration, the afternoon is free to wander at your leisure. Discover hidden gems in the city's boutiques, where master artisans showcase their craftsmanship, indulge in local delicacies at charming trattorias or unwind with a glass of Chianti, the renowned wine of Tuscany.

data.name: Private Luxury Transfer from Fiumicino Airport to Rome
data.description: Book these comfortable private transfers by luxury Mercedes-Benz from Fiumicino Airport to your accomodation located within the Aurelian Walls of Rome and start to enjoy your vacation or business trip in style.  A professional driver will be waiting in the airport meeting point with a sign with your name on to easly recognize him. There’s no need to worry about flight or customs delays as the driver will wait up to 1.5 hours without extra charge. Then, sit back and relax as they negotiate the busy and unfamliar roads to quicklt get you to your hotel.  Forget the stress of finding a taxi on arrival, or dealing with the public transportation system. The service is available from 7am to 9pm.  After collecting the luggages, pass through the sliding glass door. You will find your driver at the meeting point of the arrival terminal.

data.name: Tour by Night Rome
data.description:
Our tours are private and run by an English speaking driver.

We always strive to make travelers who want to enjoy Rome at night happy.

data.name: Vatican Pasta class with full wine tasting 4wines in cozy rooftop
data.description:
Embark on a memorable culinary journey in the heart of Rome, just steps away from the Vatican, with Pasta and Tiramisù cooking class with complete Wine Tasting on a charming rooftop terrace. In an intimate setting, guided by a skilled chef, you’ll learn the art of traditional Italian cooking, from creating fresh, homemade pasta, to mastering the classic dessert, tiramisu and to taste some of the most typical DOC wines.

A magical experience awaits you!!

data.name: Rome: Villa Borghese Gardens Baby Private Photoshoot
data.description: This private photo session in Rome is designed for families with babies or toddlers. Instead of struggling to take your own photos, let someone else do the hard work for you—with this professional photoshoot. Set in Villa Borghese Gardens, this calm setting makes the perfect backdrop for photographs of your little one, with digitally edited photos delivered after the experience.

data.name: Rome Food and Wine Tour in Trastevere Neighborhood at Sunset
data.description: There’s no better place to dive into authentic Italian dishes and drinks than Rome’s Trastevere neighborhood. From enoteca to osteria, you’ll get a true flavor of what makes Rome’s cuisine so unique and delicious.Start the evening by getting to know your local guide and a small group of travelers over a glass of wine or prosecco paired with cured meats and cheeses from the region. Afterward, pop by a family-run restaurant making the best supplì (Italian rice balls) in town for over 40 years on your way to try Rome's beloved cocktail. Take a short walk to a cozy wine bar to sample three types of bruschetta with a glass of red and white wine. Then, sit down at a typical trattoria for a family-style pasta dinner and more wine.No trip to Rome is complete without gelato! Enjoy a cup or cone before parting ways with your guide. You’ll end the tour with invaluable insight into how to eat like a local for the rest of your visit.

data.name: Frascati Wine Tasting Tour from Rome
data.description: Escape the crowds in Rome and discover the peaceful Castelli Romani hills, famed for its wine production since ancient times. Skip the hassle of the train with hotel pickup and a scenic drive aboard a private vehicle directly to one of the most historic wineries in Frascati. Tour the vineyards and barrel room before sitting down to taste a variety of wines paired with olive oil and other local treats.

data.name: Appian Way and Saint Sebastian guided tour with entrance tickets
data.description: Your tour of the Appian Way and the Catacombs of Rome provides a distinctive opportunity to delve into some of the most mesmerizing sites of the Eternal City. This expedition takes you deep into Christian Rome, featuring an inside visit to the Catacombs of Saint Sebastian. With a Spanish-speaking guide, priority access, and entrance tickets included, you'll submerge yourself in the ancient history of the Appian Way, one of the oldest and most significant Roman roads.Following a stroll along the remarkable Appian Way, you'll explore the Catacombs of Saint Sebastian, where you'll uncover the intriguing history of early Christians in Rome. Away from the city centre's hustle and bustle, the serene atmosphere of the Appian Way and its natural surroundings allow you to experience both the magnificence of ancient Rome and the challenges encountered by its first Christians.This is a comprehensive, authentic, and memorable tour.

data.name: Pizza Making Class in Rome (Includes 4-Course Meal)
data.description:
Step into a local Roman kitchen and roll up your sleeves for a fun, hands-on exploration of Italy’s most beloved food. Under the guidance of your pizza chef, prepare pizza dough from scratch and shape it into four distinct creations. Bake a classic Margherita, a hearty salami and mushroom pie, a colorful vegetable pizza and finish with a sweet Nutella dessert pizza.

Conclude your meal with Italian espresso and a traditional ammazzacaffè liqueur in an intimate group setting. Bring wine or beer if you wish and leave with the skills to recreate Rome’s pizza magic at home.

data.name: Tour delle catacombe di Roma a San Callisto
data.description: Le catacombe di San Callisto sono una delle attrazioni più affascinanti di Roma, ma la loro posizione, fuori dal centro città, è difficile da raggiungere con i mezzi pubblici. Con questo tour tutto compreso, potrai evitare di prendere l'autobus e usufruire del servizio di prelievo dall'hotel che ti farà risparmiare tempo. Raggiungi l'ingresso delle catacombe sulla Via Appia senza stress, per visitare l'antico luogo di sepoltura dei cristiani con una guida ufficiale del Vaticano.

data.name: Guided tour of Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill
data.description: Meet your tour guide for a comprehensive exploration of the Colosseum, Roman Forum and Palatine Hill. Delve into the heart of ancient Rome and uncover the pivotal landmarks that were once the epicentre of the city's institutions. Stroll across Palatine Hill, one of Rome's famed seven hills, where imperial residences were erected and the foundations of the city were laid. Absorb the awe-inspiring panorama of Imperial Rome from this vantage point. Lastly, behold the iconic Colosseum, globally renowned as one of the most impressive amphitheatres. Here, you'll learn about the grand yet sombre gladiatorial and beast combat spectacles that once took place.

data.name: OT Rome English Guided Tour with Colosseum Ticket, Palatine Hill and Roman Forum
data.description: TOUR HIGHLIGHTSSkip the long queues to the three largest sites of Ancient RomeEmbark on a 2.5-hour tour with a professional experienced guideEnjoy a spectacular view over the Forum from the Capitoline HillTimed Entranced access to one of the world’s most-visited and ancient monuments. With this guided tour get into the must-see sites of Roman history: the Colosseum, Palatine Hill, and Roman Forum.

data.name: Rome: Squares, Fountains, and Pantheon on Private Walking Tour
data.description:
Take your pick of a morning or afternoon tour, and connect with your private guide at either your central Rome hotel or a another convenient meeting point. Begin with a stop at Piazza di Spagna, once considered the ‘drawing room’ of Roman power brokers and still a popular rendezvous point today. Stroll over to the Trevi Fountain, where you can toss a coin into the fabulously Baroque waterworks and imagine scenes from La Dolce Vita, Roman Holiday and other classic films shot here.

Continue on through narrow streets and charming squares, along the way learning the stories behind engraved obelisks, historic buildings, and stately palaces. See one-time papal residences that today host modern offices, and reach back to the city’s imperial glory days inside the magnificent Pantheon, one of Rome’s best-preserved ancient monuments. Your guide may also throw in some unexpected adventures tailored to your departure point, such as a coffee break in a Renaissance cloister or historic cafe, a visit to a family-run sculpture atelier, or a detour to ancient underground ruins.

The 3-hour tour concludes in lovely Piazza Navona — the perfect place to people watch among Baroque sculptures and fountains including Bernini’s famous Fountain of the Four Rivers.

data.name: Half-Day Food and Wine Tasting Tour in Rome
data.description: Eat your way through Rome with a local guiding the way during this half-day food and wine tour. Stroll through Campo de’ Fiori and Trastevere to sample traditional Roman fare including baccala fritto (fried cod) and pizza al taglio (pizza by the slice). Learn about the stories behind classic dishes and meet local shop owners and artisans. Finish the tour with a taste of creamy gelato.

data.name: Rome Campo de Fiori, Ghetto and Pantheon Street Food Tour
data.description: Taste your way through Rome's street food scene in the picturesque, historical center. Indulge and sample delicious, traditional foods side-by-side locals: cured meat, wine, the city's best pizza, and supplì, a local specialty from Rome. You will also explore the neighborhoods, primarily Campo de Fiori and the Jewish Ghetto, with a taste of their famous deep-fried artichoke! See remains of ancient Roman structures, Rome's synagogue (only outside), and the place where Julius Caesar was murdered before heading to explore the Pantheon area to finish with a glorious gelato: you will learn about history and (food) culture all along the way.

data.name: Rome Night Walking Tour With Pantheon, Forum, Colosseum
data.description: This small-group tour explores Rome in the evening when the temperatures cool and tourist crowds disperse. Start at Piazza Navona, one of Rome’s most beloved public squares and home of Bernini’s Fountain of the Four Rivers. Then, follow your guide to the Pantheon, Trevi Fountain, Roman Forum, and other top sights in central Rome. Finish with panoramic views of the Colosseum.

data.name: Ancient Rome Half-Day Walking Tour with Colosseum Admission
data.description:
Begin your half-day exploration of Rome by bypassing the usual queues at the Colosseum and venturing straight inside with your own dedicated guide. Wander across the first and second tiers of this famed arena, hearing tales of the seat assignments that once reflected strict social hierarchies, and learn about the brutal gladiatorial spectacles that once kept thousands of spectators enthralled.

Exit the amphitheater and move on to the adjacent ruins, where the bustling political and commercial heart of ancient Rome once thrived. Arrive at the Roman Forum to see significant remains like the Temple of Caesar and listen to anecdotes of power struggles and betrayals that shaped the Roman Republic and Empire. Pause at other historically important ruins, such as the Arch of Septimius Severus, the Gemonian Steps, and the Temple of Vespasian and Titus.

Continue into the historic center of modern Rome to admire iconic landmarks like the elegant Trevi Fountain and the monumental Pantheon. Conclude your tour at Piazza Navona, home to three distinctive Baroque fountains designed by Bernini. This lively square is a convenient springboard for further independent exploration of the Eternal City.

data.name: Pantheon Guided Tour
data.description: If you’re short on time and haven’t had a chance to research the Pantheon’s history, this quick tour is the perfect solution. Skip the long ticket lines with included admission, then join a guide who leads you through the building, uncovering hidden secrets and highlighting key features you might otherwise miss.

data.name: Rome: Private Golf Cart Tour and Group Vatican Tour
data.description: Spend a day exploring Rome with a mix of sightseeing on a private golf cart and exploring the Vatican Museums on a group tour. Ask your private guide as many questions as you like about sights such as the Spanish Steps and the Trevi Fountain. Your ticket to the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel is included for a stress-free experience.

data.name: After Dinner: Roman Coffee & Dessert Food Tour by Night
data.description: After a perfect Roman dinner, leave room for dessert! Top off a perfect day or eating and sightseeing in Rome with this Coffee and Dessert Food tour timed to start just after dinner. Discover the locations every sweet-loving Roman knows. Learn which desserts are in season at the time you are travelling. Perhaps try a "maritozzo" -- a sweet bun packed with fresh whipped cream - is a Roman classic dating back to ancient Rome. Have your pick from over 150 flavors of home-made Gelato made from scratch. Try a Tiramisù ( translated literally: "pick me up") at the place everyone on Trip Advisor calls "the Best Tiramisù in town". Enjoy a frothy cappuccino or an espresso coffee at a traditional bar. Learn how to order one of the many variations of Italian coffee on your own, just like a local. Stops may vary from tour to tour based on seasonality. The itinerary covers the historic heart of Rome and includes stops to enjoy Rome's famous monuments illuminated at night.

data.name: Secrets of Rome Walking Tour- Up To 6 People
data.description: Immerse yourself in the essence of Rome by navigating the charming cobblestone streets of Trastevere, a historic neighborhood known for its bohemian vibe and mouthwatering cuisine. Wander through the narrow alleys filled with colorful buildings, quaint shops, and lively piazzas, stopping to sample the area's specialty dishes like carbonara, amatriciana, and cacio e pepe at local trattorias. Visit the 12th-century Basilica di Santa Maria in Trastevere, adorned with stunning mosaics, and the charming Piazza Santa Maria in Trastevere, where locals gather to socialize and enjoy the evening ambiance.

data.name: Rome: Pasta and Tiramisu Workshop
data.description: Just wear your chef hat and apron and you will be ready to work! Firstly, you will prepare your own pasta with flour and eggs; the chef will show you which kind of pasta you can prepare with this recipe and you will choose which cut to use. Once the pasta is ready, you'll go on preparing tiramisù. After the workshop, you'll choose your topping sauce (carbonara, amatriciana, cacio e pepe, alfredo etc.) and relax with a good glass of wine, while in the restaurant's kitchen our chef will cook your pasta.Your meal's menu will consist ofFettuccine with chosen sauceTiramisu1 glass of wineLimoncello or coffeeWater

data.name: Visita guiada ao Museu do Vaticano e à Capela Sistina
data.description: Mergulhe na história, na arte e na espiritualidade com nossa visita guiada exclusiva de três horas em Museus do Vaticano e a magnífica Capela Sistina.Sua aventura começa com uma entrada privilegiada nos Museus do Vaticano, evitando as longas filas de espera. Acompanhado por um guia especialista, você será transportado no tempo, descobrindo os tesouros artísticos acumulados pelos papas ao longo dos séculos. Cada galeria é uma porta aberta para uma época diferente, desde esculturas antigas até obras-primas do Renascimento. Você ficará deslumbrado com as maravilhas das Salas de Rafael e a extraordinária Galeria dos Mapas Geográficos, onde cada canto conta uma história fascinante.A visita culmina na icônica Capela Sistina, um santuário de arte sagrada. Ao olhar para o teto, você ficará maravilhado com a grandiosidade do afresco de Michelangelo, representando a Criação de Adão e o Juízo Final. Seu guia revelará os segredos e simbolismos ocultos nessas obras monumentais, oferecendo-lhe uma compreensão profunda da arte e da teologia que se entrelaçam nesse espaço sagrado.

data.name: Private Day Tour to Pompeii & Sorrento with Professional Guide
data.description: Explore the ancient ruins of Pompeii, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, on this private day tour from Rome. Travel by comfortable, air-conditioned minivan with a professional English and Spanish-speaking driver. Discover Pompeii's fascinating history, preserved by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD. The tour also includes a visit to the charming seaside town of Sorrento, offering scenic views and local culture. Enjoy a personalized, private experience tailored to your pace.

data.name: Rome Sightseeing Tour With Private Option and Pickup
data.description: If you’re short on Rome vacation time, but your sightseeing wishlist is long, this tour has you checking off a wealth of famous city sights off at speed, including the Trevi Fountain, the Colosseum, St. Peter’s Basilica, and more. Enjoy a far more personal touring experience by opting for a private group, and feel free to pick your guide’s brain as you go.

data.name: Rome: Vatican Museums Skip-the-Line Private Highlights Tour

data.description: Discover one of the Papal Basilicas and its treasures: Santa Maria Maggiore with an audio guide and a visit to the Dome.The Papal Basilica of Santa Maria Maggiore has dominated the city of Rome for sixteen centuries: an excellent Marian temple and cradle of artistic civilization.Located on the top of the Esquiline Hill, it is one of the four Papal Basilicas of Rome. The numerous treasures it contains make Santa Maria Maggiore a place where art and spirituality come together in a perfect union, offering visitors those unique emotions. Admire the tomb of the Bernini family, the Baptistery, the Holy Door, and many other masterpieces.Enjoy the breathtaking view from the Dome of Santa Maria Maggiore, it will open up a panoramic view of the city and will leave you enchanted. data.name: Full day in Florence from Rome
data.description: Early departure from Rome - Termini Station. Take the high-speed train and in 1 hour and 30 minutes, you will reach Florence. Upon arrival, head to the city center and meet our local guide who will lead you to discover the history of Florence, from the Roman city to the origins of a fifteenth-century palace, from the Ponte Vecchio, through the famous Uffizi courtyard, to the wonders of Brunelleschi's Dome architecture overlooking the "Gates of Paradise" of the Baptistery. After the guided tour of the city, let yourself be guided to the famous Accademia Gallery, where together with the group, you will learn why David is the most recognizable symbol of Florence and what it represented in its time. How did Michelangelo's genius tackle the challenge of extracting the pathos of a being and fix it forever in the Pietà, or the famous Prisoners who still seem to free themselves from their blocks of marble? You will have the answers to all your questions. Take the opportunity to have a close encounter with timeless artworks and learn about the history of life and the times lived by this artist. Once the visit is over, enjoy some free time for lunch at a restaurant of your choice. Try the renowned Florentine steak or a good plate of pici, a typical pasta from the Tuscany region. In the afternoon, explore another one of the world's most famous museums: the Uffizi Gallery. Your expert guide will explain the works of the greatest artists of the Middle Ages. You will recognize the original paintings of world fame that you have seen in books, magazines, and on TV. You will learn about the secrets of art, techniques, and the artist's tools. By looking at the most famous works of the period, you will be able to understand why Florence was the cradle of the Renaissance. The tour ends at the Uffizi Gallery, where you will have the opportunity to stay longer and wander on your own. Finally, in the late afternoon, take the high-speed train and enjoy a relaxing journey back to Rome.

data.name: Evening Tour of Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel
data.description: This evening tour provides a rare chance to wander through the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel after hours, when it's quieter and the artwork takes on a new dimension. It's an ideal way to round off a day in Rome, blending awe-inspiring art, centuries of history, and spectacular views of the Eternal City at sunset.Your journey begins as you ascend the Vatican’s twisting staircase, leading you to the historic Pinecone Courtyard. Here, the tranquil evening ambiance offers a serene backdrop for soaking up your surroundings.Next, you'll be guided through key highlights of the museum such as the Gallery of Tapestries, where complex designs narrate historical events, and the Hall of Maps, displaying exquisitely illustrated maps of Italy. You'll uncover the intriguing tales behind the art and the visionaries who brought them to life, including Renaissance luminaries like Raphael.The evening progresses with one of the most emblematic stops in the Vatican – the Sistine Chapel. Upon entering, you'll gain insights into Michelangelo’s masterpieces, from his concealed self-portrait to the symbolic imagery embedded within the frescoes.After marvelling at the Sistine Chapel’s astounding beauty, you'll venture back outside, where the calm evening atmosphere of the Vatican grounds offers a final moment of contemplation. The lit-up St. Peter’s Basilica and the quiet surroundings provide the ideal conclusion to an unique experience.

data.name: Pompeii day trip from Rome by high-speed train with guided tour
data.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey from Rome to Pompeii, one of the most significant archaeological sites in the world. Travel quickly and comfortably on a high-speed train, making this an ideal day trip from Rome. Board a fast train from Rome and in less than two hours, you'll find yourself at Pompeii. Sit back, relax and soak up the scenic Italian landscapes as you head south, ready to delve into the ancient world of Pompeii.Upon arrival, step into a living history museum. Pompeii, buried by volcanic ash centuries ago, provides a one-of-a-kind snapshot of Roman life. Stroll through its ancient streets, marvelling at the well-preserved buildings, temples, and houses. Visit the Forum, the city's hub where political and public life once thrived amidst grand ruins. Discover the House of the Vettii, a prosperous home adorned with vivid frescoes, and the Villa of the Mysteries, renowned for its striking murals that have puzzled historians. Visit the ancient theatre where citizens enjoyed performances, and the baths that offer insights into Roman culture and leisure. The iconic casts of victims preserved in volcanic ash provide a poignant connection to the past.After your tour, savour local flavours with a Neapolitan pizza, fresh mozzarella di bufala, and other regional delicacies. Take some time to explore the town of Pompeii, with its bustling squares and markets. Relax with a coffee or gelato before boarding your high-speed train back to Rome.

data.description: From the hilly areas of Marino and Genzano di Roma, to the peaks of Rocca di Papa and Rocca Priora, the Castelli Romani towns are characterized by a wide variety of spaces. Discover the Roman Castles through the archeology of the Colli Albani, the historical residences, the Via Francigena, the Vie del Sacro and the path of the Two Lakes. These are itineraries to appreciate the landscape and natural beauty of the territory, its flavors, tastes and aromas; it is the genuineness that gives unique characteristics to the dishes of our kitchen. First we’ll visit Castel Gandolfo – a lovely town where the Pope has his summer residence. These towns lay in a dormant volcanic crater which has provided fertile land for the growth of grapes and the production of wine. This means we cannot miss a stop to a local wine cellar with the visit of its vineyard and a tasting of local food and wine. data.description: Your day will start with convenient pickup service from your accommodations within the Aurelian Walls (designated meeting place for those staying outside the Aurelian Walls). Once in Tivoli, you will visit both UNESCO World Heritage Sites with a professional guide. Admire the exquisite Hadrian's Villa, built by Emperor Hadrian during the 2nd century and home to emperors for more than 50 years. See the stunning Greek Architecture and picturesque landscape. Stroll through the gardens, 120-hectares inspired by the wonders of Rome, Egypt, and Athens. Then, you will go to Villa d'Este, built during the 16th century by Cardinal Ippolito II d'Este. Explore the beauty of Italian Renaissance architecture with its gardens, fountains, and waterfalls. Step back into history as your guide provides you insight about the notable Roman families that built this villa and called it home. Return to your accommodations in Rome by mid-afternoon.

data.name: Freddie Mercury Opera Show
data.description: Explore a novel interpretation of Queen's iconic tracks, transformed for Italian opera virtuosos from the Opera da Camera di Roma ensemble and piano accompaniment. The show not only celebrates Mercury's oeuvre but also introduces compositions once performed for royalty, by none other than G. F. Handel. Complementing Freddie's diverse heritage, attendees will enjoy segments of traditional Indian music, linking the legendary rock vocalist to historical singing sensation Farinelli of the 18th century. Both shared a connection through magnificent venues that bridged centuries. Mercury's own passion for opera, famously showcased in his performances with soprano Montserrat Caballé, inspires this unprecedented concert in Rome, promising a collection of extraordinary musical delights. data.name: Rome Vatican St Peter's Basilica & Dome Private Tour & Breakfast
