data.name: Beauty and Ghosts Walking Tour in Rome- Up To 6 People
data.description: Join us for an enchanting tour of Rome that delves into its rich history and ghostly lore, starting at the stunning St. Peter’s Square with a breathtaking view of the Basilica. We’ll explore the haunting tales of Castel Sant’Angelo, including the tragic story of Beatrice Cenci, before wandering to Piazza Navona and Campo de’ Fiori, where you'll uncover chilling narratives of notorious figures condemned by the Church. Finally, we’ll conclude at Piazza Farnese, where more ghost stories await. Embrace the spookiness and discover the unseen side of the Eternal City!

data.name: Naples and Amalfi coast full day tour from Rome
data.description: From Rome you will drive to Naples and start with a visit to “Spaccanapoli”, Via San Gregorio Armeno, Piazza San Domenico, Piazza del Gesù with the Church of Gesù Nuovo and the Basilica of Santa Chiara (the largest Gothic church in Naples). Continue to visit the monumental area and see the Piazza Plebiscito, where you can see the Royal Palace and the Church of San Francesco di Paola. Then head to Via Toledo, where you will be able to admire the splendid Galleria Umberto I, and on to Piazza Municipio, where there is the imposing Angevin fortress of Castle Nuovo. You will have the opportunity to make a brief stop in a former bakery to taste the famous “sfogliatella.” After this visit and a break, in the afternoon your guide will drive you to Amalfi. The Amalfi Coast is known for being the land of the orange blossoms and lemon trees. Enjoy the saltiness of the marvelous beaches and the wildest Mediterranean scrub, arranged in a vertical manner, together with the houses overlooking the sea and hidden in the maze of picturesque alleys. It is like a cluster of white houses, clinging to the rocks and connected by covered alleys and stairways. At the center of the main square is the Cathedral of Sant'Andrea with the spectacular staircase and the bell tower in Arab-Norman style. Your journey will continue visiting the splendid Positano, one of the most famous places on the Amalfi Coast, for its suggestive staircases and the whitewashed houses that follow the mountains course, creating a vertical landscape. Appreciated by artists and jet-set characters since the early post-war, the town is famous for the production of leather sandals,cotton and linen clothes and for the beautiful Majolica.

data.name: Rome Private Family-Friendly Sightseeing Tour with Snack
data.description: On this tour, visit famed landmarks, local eateries, and off-the-beaten path locations led by a local guide. A great tour for families, your guide keeps things entertaining for the little ones with fun games and activities. Grab a street food snack to keep you fueled while enjoying a view of the Pantheon and other iconic sights. This private tour is completely customizable to fit the ages and interests of your kids

data.name: Rome to Postiano Hotel: Private Transfer with Pompeii Stopover
data.description:
The journey begins with a pick-up directly from your hotel or airport in Rome.

A luxury car where a professional driver awaits you, ready to ensure a smooth and relaxing journey.

As you leave the city behind, Rome slowly dissolves in the rearview mirror: the Colosseum, the Dome of St. Peter and its historic alleys.

After about 3 hours and 30 minutes, the journey ends in the most magical way possible.

Ravello, with its gardens of Villa Cimbrone and Villa Rufolo, its silent alleys and panoramic terraces, offers a unique welcome.

Whether for a relaxing holiday or a romantic stay, the transfer from Rome to Ravello is not just a journey: it is an experience that transforms the journey into an unforgettable part of your adventure on the Amalfi Coast.

data.name: Cortona and Arezzo Full-Day Small-Group Tour from Rome
data.description: During the tour you can explore narrow and charming streets and visit the most picturesque and hidden corners of Cortona. Together with the guide you will also be able to retrace the places of the movie "Under the Tuscan Sun" and take a look at the famous Villa Bramasole. After Cortona, you can visit Arezzo, one of the richest city of the region, situated at the top of an hill. Here you will see the Basilica of San Francesco, well known for  the wonderful cycle of frescoes, the "Legend of the True Cross" masterpiece of Piero della Francesca, the Cathedral , with its beautiful stained glass windows, and the Piazza Grande, famous for being the set of the Roberto Benigni’s movie "Life is beautiful".

data.name: The Three Tenors in Rome: Nessun Dorma in St. Paul's Within the Walls
data.description: In the heart of Rome, three tenors will be joined by dancers in costume accompanied by the Orchestra of the great Neapolitan mandolins and grand piano, for a performance featuring opera arias and famous traditional Neapolitan songs. The program includes such magical melodies as 'Torna a Surriento', 'O’ sole mio', and 'Funiculì funiculà', as well as enchanting opera arias. Add a touch of Italian music to your stay in Italy with this festive event.

data.name: Rome Private Family-Friendly City Tour with Food Tasting
data.description: If you’re struggling to keep the kids engaged during your Rome sightseeing, this family-friendly tour solves that too-common dilemma—by combining ancient history with fun activities. Little ones will stay entertained with games, treasure hunts, and playground stops, and everyone samples authentic Roman treats, like pizza, suppli, chocolates, and gelato. Your private guide provides captivating stories for the kids, valuable tips for the adults, and more.

data.name: Rome food tour in Campo de Fiori, Jewish Ghetto and Trastevere
data.description: Embark on a culinary journey through Rome's iconic neighbourhoods with this food and wine tour.Taste the essence of Campo de' Fiori's bustling market, savor unique Roman-Jewish dishes in the charming streets of the Jewish Ghetto, and enjoy VIP access to renowned restaurants in Trastevere. Indulge in the legendary Jewish-style artichoke at Da Enzo and savor a pasta feast paired with exceptional wine at Spirito Divino, boasting a wine cellar older than the Colosseum. Learn more about the city's history and tradition thanks to an expert guide. During this tour you'll uncover hidden passages, discover historical treasures, and immerse yourself in the flavors of Rome's culinary heritage. With 6 tantalizing food stops and 3 refreshing drink samples, this tour promises a multisensory journey you won't want to miss.Don't miss this chance to explore the city through its delectable delights.

data.name: Oratorio Del Gonfalone: The music of silence: from Palestrina to the prayer of nature
data.description: Nestled in the heart of Rome, the Oratorio del Gonfalone invites you to immerse yourself in a serene and transcendent musical experience titled 'The music of silence: from Palestrina to the prayer of nature.' This enchanting event takes you on a journey through the intricate beauty of polyphonic choral music, starting from the ethereal compositions of Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina. Delight in the soothing harmony of Renaissance music as it transitions into a heartfelt tribute to nature, evoking a sense of calm and spirituality that words fail to capture. Held within the historic walls of the Oratorio del Gonfalone, this musical event promises to be a feast for the senses. Experience the sublime acoustics of the venue, where the voices create a mesmerizing soundscape that resonates like an echo of the divine. Program: • G.P. da Palestrina – Ave Regina Coelorum, Gaude Virgo Gloriosa, Alma Redemptoris Mater, Pueri Hebraeorum, Jesu Rex Admirabilis, Sub tuum praesidium • Giovanni Aichinger – Regina Coeli • Adrian Willaert – Regina Coeli • Antonio Lotti – Vere languores nostros Gustav Holst – Two Eastern Pictures (Spring, Summer) • Josef Rheinberger – Maitag Op. 64 (Früh Morgens, Ballade, Mittagsruhe, Heimfahrt) • Tradizione nativi americani – Evening Rise

data.name: Rome: Private Golf Cart Sightseeing Tour with Nighttime Option
data.description: Rome is a large city with attractions to see in every corner, which can be pretty tiring if you’re walking everywhere or navigating public transportation. However, with a private golf cart tour of the city’s sights, you can put all of your energy towards experiencing Rome’s attractions. Learn about both the famous ones and the lesser-known gems from your driver-guide as they show you around.

data.name: Rome Walking Tour of the Eternal City
data.description: Uncover Rome’s layered history on a walking tour of the Eternal City that connects ancient landmarks with lively city streets. Start at Piazza Navona to view Bernini’s Fountain of the Four Rivers, then explore the Pantheon and its massive unreinforced concrete dome. Finish at the Trevi Fountain and Spanish Steps. Navigate key sites while gaining insight into Rome’s timeless blend of past and present.

data.name: Trevi Fountain and Underground Aqueducts 2.5-Hour Private Tour
data.description: The Trevi Fountain is one of Rome’s popular attractions, but few visitors take the time to understand the ancient engineering behind its iconic water system. During this private tour, venture below the crowds gathering to throw coins in the Trevi to the underground aqueducts still supplying the city with water after millennia. Admission tickets to Vicus Caprarius, the City of Water, are included.

data.name: Pompeii Guided Tour with Train Included from Rome
data.description:
Enjoy a visit to the Archaeological Park of Pompeii in the company of a professional guide, who will allow you to immerse yourself in a world never forgotten full of charm. Discover all the secrets of the most famous city in the Ancient World.

In addition, this tour is ideal for any type of traveler: family, adventure seekers or lovers of history and culture!

data.name: Rome to Capri Island Full-Day Private Tour
data.description: The island of Capri features dramatic landscapes, historic landmarks, and upmarket shopping neighborhoods. On this full-day private tour, set out from Rome on a journey to explore the island. Head to nearby Naples and hop aboard a cruise vessel before exploring Capri’s rich variety of experiences, all framed by the deep blue Mediterranean ocean.

data.name: St. Peter’s Basilica and Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel Entry
data.description:
Make the most of your time in Rome with this seamless Vatican experience combining on-site assistance at St. Peter’s Basilica and skip-the-line access to the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel.

Start your journey at the Basilica of St. Peter, the world’s largest and most iconic church. Meet your multilingual host at the meeting point, and receive practical info, tips, and support to help you explore this spiritual and artistic wonder at your own pace. Admire masterpieces like Michelangelo’s Pietà, the Baldachin by Bernini, and the towering dome overlooking Rome.

Then, skip the long lines with priority entry tickets to the Vatican Museums and the Sistine Chapel. Walk through the legendary Gallery of Maps, the Tapestry Hall, and of course, gaze up in awe at Michelangelo’s frescoed ceiling in the Sistine Chapel—one of the greatest treasures of Renaissance art.

Get ready for a stress-free and unforgettable dive into the heart of the Vatican City, rich in history and beauty.

data.name: Castel Sant'Angelo priority line ticket with audio guide
data.description: Discover the rich history of Castel Sant’Angelo with worry-free priority tickets. Explore the fortress which once housed popes and noble families with an audio guide leading your journey.Step into the Mausoleum of Hadrian that was built nearly 2000 years ago. With 18 points of interest, hear the castle’s storied history starting with the Roman Empire. Legend has it the plague of 590 ended when Archangel Michael stood on top of the mausoleum.Listen in your own language as you explore the building’s transition into a castle and prison. The courtyard was the site of executions – and the setting where characters from Puccini's famous opera, Tosca, were imprisoned. Today, Castle Sant’Angelo is one of Rome’s most iconic and beloved museums.

data.name: Private Golf Cart Tour: Explore Rome in Comfort and Style
data.description: Discover Rome's history and charm on a private golf cart tour tailored to your interests. Enjoy a personalized itinerary crafted by your expert guide as you explore iconic landmarks, palaces, fountains, and more. Cruise comfortably through Rome’s streets, including restricted traffic zones, with stops for gelato or coffee along the way. This eco-friendly and flexible experience ensures a memorable journey through over 2,500 years of history.

data.name: Discover Rome in a Classic Fiat 500
data.description:
Ready to explore Rome in the most unforgettable way?

Join us for a one-of-a-kind experience through the Eternal City in a vintage Fiat 500—the ultimate symbol of Italian charm and style! With us, you won’t just see Rome, you’ll feel its heartbeat as we cruise past iconic landmarks and hidden gems.

Our journey starts in the historic Monti district, winds past the majestic Colosseum, and sweeps through ancient sites like Circo Massimo. We’ll stop at the stunning Orange Gardens and the Baroque Fountain of Acqua Paola, where you’ll have time to take photos and soak in the views. Our final stop is the scenic Piazzetta Garibaldi, followed by a relaxing ride back through the lively streets of Trastevere.

Whether it’s your first time in Rome or your fifth, this tour offers an authentic, stylish, and memorable adventure you won't find anywhere else.

Hop in, feel the breeze, and see Rome like never before—book your tour with us today!

data.name: Fiumicino Airport from/to Vaticano Transfer
data.description:
Enjoy a convenient and reliable transfer service between Fiumicino Airport and the Vatican, with round-trip departures available. Each journey takes approximately 50 minutes.

Strategically Located Stops:

At Fiumicino Airport, the bus departs from Terminal 3, first parking lane #12, on the right-hand side.

In the Vatican area, the stop is located at Via Crescenzio 2, directly opposite the restaurant Il Tartarughino.

An additional stop is also available near Cornelia Metro Station, (Circonvallazione Aurelia 19), offering even more flexibility

Friendly staff are always present at the bus stops to assist passengers. Tickets are redeemed on board, making the boarding process quick and easy. Passengers are kindly asked to arrive at the bus stop at least 15 minutes before departure to confirm their presence.

This service provides a seamless direct connection to and from two of Rome’s most significant hubs, with dedicated support and strategically placed stops for maximum convenience.

data.name: Fast-Access Castel Sant’Angelo Entry and Optional Audio Guide
data.description: Waste no time on your visit to Rome’s Castel Sant’Angelo with this fast-access ticket. Like many attractions in the capital, Castel Sant’Angelo is a popular site, and it’s worth booking in advance to secure your entry. Simply book online, redeem your voucher at the on-site ticket office, then head inside. Note: There are smartphone specifications for the audio tour; check "What's Included" before you book.

data.name: Amalfi Coast: Private One-Way Transfer Service From Rome
data.description: Heading to the Amalfi Coast from Rome on your own can be stressful and challenging, whether you’re trying to navigate Italy’s roads or its public transportation. Instead, avoid that stress—and enjoy a fully personalized experience—on this private transfer service that’s tailored to your schedule and preferences. Leave the navigation and logistics to your driver so you can enjoy the scenery and relax en route.

data.name: Rome Highlights with Pantheon: 2-Hour Sightseeing Walking Tour
data.description: Get a comprehensive overview of the ‘Eternal City’ on this private walking tour. Discover Rome’s famous landmarks including Piazza Navona, the Trevi Fountain, and the Pantheon, and learn about the rich and vibrant history of the city from your informative guide. Listen to stories and anecdotes about the 2,000-year-old city while taking in the stunning architecture.

data.name: Rome: Campo de’ Fiori, Pantheon Small-Group Food Walking Tour
data.description: Discover many of Rome’s best-known landmarks in a single excursion—and pair your sightseeing with a tasting tour of the city’s delicacies—on this two-in-one outing. With just your guide and small group for company, set off to discover the Trevi Fountain, Piazza Navona, Campo de’ Fiori (and its market), and more. Along the way, savor gourmet tastings from coffee and salami to gelato and beyond.

data.name: Oratorio Del Gonfalone: 50th Anniversary Shostakovich: A Journey through Sounds and Memories with Gentile
data.description: 50th Anniversary Shostakovich: A Journey through Sounds and Memories with Gentile in Rome at the Oratorio del Gonfalone. Programma: • Dmitri Shostakovich – Trio n. 2 in mi minore op. 67 • Ada Gentile – Serene ombre

data.name: Dan Brown Inferno tour in Florence - Daytrip from Rome
data.description: Visit the centre of Florence through the eyes of Robert Langdon, the famous Harvard University symbolist born from Dan Brown's books. Retracing the steps of the movie "Inferno", you will revive the culture and the history of one of the most famous town of Italy, discovering the mysteries that lie behind the Florentine art. The underlying theme of the tour will be the "Dante's Inferno", which will take you from the Porta Romana up to the Boboli Gardens, through the famous Ponte Vecchio to Piazza della Signoria taking a look at the ingenious Vasarian Corridor, and from the House of Dante to the Baptistery of St John with its Paradise door. You will spend a wonderful day by solving the puzzles of an intricate plot with no clearly defined boundaries between fiction and reality, in which not only the medieval  and Renaissance buildings, but also their inhabitants, such Dante, Boccaccio and Beatrice, will frame the events of Langdon and Sienna during their visit to this unforgettable city.

data.name: Rome Private and Customizable Photo Shoot
data.description: Come home with more than selfies as a souvenir of your Roman holiday with this private photo shoot. Meet with a local photographer in Rome’s Monti neighborhood to pose near the Colosseum or opt to customize your shoot at other beautiful locations like the Trevi Fountain or Piazza Navona. Spend an hour having fun creating great shots with your professional photographer. Ideal for couples and families wanting better vacation pictures.

data.name: Rome to/From Florence Private Transfer Service, Orvieto Option
data.description: Traveling between Rome and Florence doesn’t have to be stressful. Skip the confusing public transit and avoid the air travel, all thanks to this private, one-way transfer service. Meet your driver at a time and place that work best for you, receive their help with your bags, and then enjoy a smooth and relaxing trip. No matter your direction of travel, you can also add on a sightseeing stop in Orvieto en route.

data.name: Rome by Golf Cart Sightseeing Tour
data.description: Rome covers a vast area and getting around the city on foot or with public transportation to see the top sights can be tiring. With this golf cart tour, zip between the blockbuster attractions quickly and without getting footsore. Stop at A-list landmarks, fountains, and squares to snap photos or stretch your legs and enjoy a coffee or gelato break (own expense) along the way.

data.name: Rome: Colosseum with Access to Arena Floor and Ancient Rome
data.description: You will be able to live a unique experience by having the opportunity to enter the Colosseum Arena and enter through the access that the gladiators used to enter inside the Colosseum. Visit the places where the famous gladiator battles took place, understanding how rigid the ancient Roman civilization was by observing the severe seating arrangement. You will enjoy one of the best views of the structure.

data.name: Rome Private Golf Cart Sightseeing Tour
data.description: Explore Rome in comfort and style on this private golf cart tour, perfect for skipping the crowds and cruising through famous sites and hidden corners. From the Colosseum to the Trevi Fountain, you’ll discover iconic landmarks and local gems at your own pace. With a personal guide sharing fascinating stories along the way, this customizable tour offers a relaxed, insightful, and memorable way to experience the Eternal City.

data.name: Visita Guiada Coliseo, Foro Romano y Palatino
data.description: Imperdible Visita guiada al Coliseo, un clásico siempre especial.No puedes irte de Roma, la Ciudad Eterna, sin visitar el Coliseo, Foro Romano y Palatino. Y si lo haces con nuestros tours guiados mejor que mejor, porque realizarás la visita sin colas, con guías oficiales de Roma y en grupos reducidos para garantizar la calidad. Nuestros guías te harán disfrutar viendo, imaginando y escuchando cómo era de verdad la vida en la Antigua Roma. Te sumergirás en un mundo fascinante de forma amena y divertida.Visitarás el Palatino, la colina donde nació Roma y donde los grandes emperadores construyeron sus palacios. También visitarás el Foro Romano, lugar donde se encontraban las grandes instituciones romanas y los templos más importantes. Y por supuesto, irás al Coliseo, el lugar más emblemático e icónico de la ciudad de Roma, donde tenían lugar las famosísimas luchas entre gladiadores. Podremos admirar la arena desde el alto y asomarnos a los espacios subterráneos que hacían posible el desarrollo de los grandes espectáculos.

data.name: Rome in 2 Full Days Private Tour
data.description: In two days you will have the opportunity to see the ancient city of Rome and the most of its Renaissance and Baroque monuments thoroughly, with a personal Official Tour Guide, Driver and minivan. One of our best sellers tours, ideated to make you discover the main Eternal City wonders in the best way. With our special schedule, you will enjoy in two days the landmarks that usually take a week to be seen. How can we do that? With a unique formula including 7 hours each day for a total of 14 hours! Discover more Minivan or sedan A/C and Private driver are included. Private Official tour guide for the vatican museums, the Colosseum, the Roman Forum and Palatine hill. Get inside the attractions like the colosseum, the roman forum and the vatican museums with your private tour guide will be very simple and easy. For last minute bookings (less than 30 days) we reserve the right to offer you alternatives or free cancellations if we are unable to carry out the service as described.

data.name: Rome Underground Treasures and Hidden Depths Tour
data.description: Tour Rome’s underground treasures and hidden depths on a guided exploration. Visit San Pietro in Vincoli to marvel at Michelangelo’s statue of Moses, wander through Parco di Colle Oppio past Nero’s Golden House, and uncover the layered wonders of Basilica di San Clemente, complete with a secret Mithraic temple. This unique tour is perfect for history lovers and curious travelers alike.

data.name: Passage under the Holy Doors with access to the Papal Basilicas
data.description: A tour of the four Papal Basilicas of Rome is a spiritual and cultural journey through the holiest places in Christianity. This special itinerary allows you to visit St. Peter's in the Vatican, St. John Lateran, St. Paul Outside the Walls and St. Mary Major, each with its own unique history, architecture and religious significance. Passing through a Holy Door is a spiritual gesture of renewal and grace, representing the passage to mercy and forgiveness. This tour is a profound experience that combines art, faith and history, ideal for those who want to experience the most authentic meaning of the Jubilee through the symbolic places of Roman spirituality.

data.name: Rome Villa Farnesina and Raphael Paintings Private Tour
data.description: Marvel at Raphael masterpieces in a Renaissance villa that flies below the radar of most tourists with this private guided visit inside Villa Farnesina. Head directly inside with fast-track tickets and explore the rooms decorated by Renaissance masters. Learn about the history and art of the villa with commentary and interactive visual tools, plus stroll through the surrounding gardens or farther into the Trastevere neighborhood.

data.name: Roman & Greek Mythology Private Tour
data.description: Dive into ancient Mythology on this unique tour in the heart of the Eternal City. You will learn about the fascinating myths and legends which made up the famous history of Rome and explore the most symbolic sites of the city. Using visual material and other multimedia tools your guide will bring the past to present and teach you about ancient culture and religion in the most engaging way. Walking in the footsteps of Roman and Greek gods you will learn how they can reveal interesting facts about our beliefs and traditions today and visit some important landmarks, including Capitol Hill, Temple of Saturn Gemin, Trajan's column, Marcello Theater and many more.

data.name: Rome Colosseum, Forum and Palatine Hill Guided Walking Tour
data.description: Embark on a journey through Rome's rich history and unlock the secrets of the iconic Colosseum, Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill on a walking tour. Delve into the gladiator games that captivated the ancient population and explore the fascinating Palatine Hill and Roman Forum, brimming with charm, history, and anecdotes about the lives of our ancient Roman predecessors.

data.name: Cooking Class with Lidia YoungGrandma in Jewish area
data.description:
This experience is truly special because it invites you to step into the heart and soul of authentic Roman cooking, lovingly passed down by real Roman young grandmother Lidia.

Set in a unique, history-filled corner of vibrant Rome, this intimate class is limited to just 6 people, ensuring you receive personal guidance and a genuine connection.

Together, we’ll roll up our sleeves and create fresh, handmade pasta from scratch, all while enjoying a traditional Roman aperitivo paired with exquisite Italian wines that will delight your senses.

I’m genuinely excited to welcome you, share stories, laughter, and unforgettable flavors - and create memories that will stay with you long after the last bite.

I can’t wait to meet you and cook together!

data.name: Rome Mythology Half-Day Private Guided Walking Tour
data.description: Learn more about Roman mythology and the roles the gods played in Roman society on this half-day private guided walking tour. Visit several sites important to the ancient Romans as they worshipped their pantheon of gods, including the Temple of Saturn, Trajan’s Column, and Capitol Hill, while hearing how the polytheistic religion gained popularity and influence.

data.name: Vatican City: Museums and Sistine Chapel Skip The Line Ticket
data.description: Explore the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel without waiting in the often long public lines. Take a journey through the awe-inspiring museums where you’ll find a treasure trove of Roman statues, Renaissance paintings, and Italian artworks. Take as much time as you like to explore the museums at your own pace

data.name: Ponza Island Day Trip from Rome with Snorkel
data.description: Relax on a full-day excursion from Rome to Ponza Island with ample time to swim and explore. Swim in the azure sea, explore sea caves, soak up the sun and eat a freshly prepared captain's sea food pasta lunch, sip wine and then spend some spare time on the island. Learn about the history of the island and its connection to the Greek poet Homer.

data.name: Small-Group Colosseum Arena Floor, Forum, Palatine Hill Tour
data.description: Experience the thrill of ancient Rome as you visit a few of the most important sites on this small-group tour of the Colosseum, Roman Forum, and Palatine Hill. Enjoy included access to the arena floor via the famed Gladiator’s Gate. Then, follow your guide to the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill to continue your tour of some of ancient Rome’s most important landmarks.

data.name: Stargazing power walking tour
data.shortDescription:
Another sparkling tour for 2025 is coming!
​With Stargazing power walking ​tour we will discover all the starry skies present in Rome... but at dawn! It will be a way to enjoy not only the classics of the city, but also new and unusual places.
We will start from Piazza del Popolo to visit churches like Sant'Agostino, Sata Maria Sopra Minerva, San Gioacchino and much more! Without forgetting the most secret and magical places of the Eternal City! It will be fun!

For 2025 ArcheoRunning has decided to launch a new idea of experiential tourism, sustainable and outside the usual patterns. Next year, due to the Jubilee, there will be an exponential growth in tourism (very often mass tourism). So to get around all this we want to propose a series of "Early bird experiences" by ArcheoRunning. data.name: Rome: City Centre Private Walking Tour with Francesca
data.description: Bring Rome's sites to life on a private walking tour with top-rated guide Francesca. See its most famous landmarks, ancient monuments, pretty squares and fountains with fascinating insights, history and stories at each one, so you'll leave feeling like you know the city.

data.name: 3-hour private tour of Rome in a vintage Fiat 500
data.description:
Would you like to live in another era? Do you love vintage songs? Hate doing the same old mundane things? Do you want to go where tour buses can't go?

If the answer is YES, welcome to the Roman “Dolce Vita”! and I welcome you aboard the Fiat 500 Vitage. You will see the monuments and tour the city as if you were a "local". Colosseum, Travertine Arch, Acquapaola Fountain, Vatican Dome, Orange Garden, Aventine and Trastevere!

You will definitely not go unnoticed during the tour

The Tour will end near the Colosseum. There are 3 seats available including the driver. We will stop for a break to have an Italian breakfast or an ice cream!

data.name: Pompeii: Skip The Line Ticket + Transport
data.description: Enjoy an air-conditioned coach ride (with free WiFi) to one of history's most fascinating sites. Once you arrive, you'll get skip-the-line access to this fascinating ancient city preserved by the lava from Mt. Vesuvius. After a day spent wandering through the eerily well-preserved remains, you'll board your bus again and be shuttled in air-conditioned comfort back to Rome.

data.name: Welcome Private Transfer from Fiumicino Airport to Hotel in Rome
data.description: Pre-book these comfortable private transfers by luxury Mercedes-Benz from Fiumicino Airport to hotels or other accommodations located within the Aurelian Walls of Rome, and start your vacation or business trip in style. An experienced driver will be waiting in the arrival’s hall with a sign with your name on it for ease of contact. Then, sit back and relax as they navigate the busy and unfamliar roads to quickly get you to your hotel. Forget the stress of finding a taxi on arrival, or dealing with the public transportation system. At all meet and greet locations, the driver will be holding a sign with your name on it for ease of contact. Forget the stress of everyday life, and enjoy the services of a chauffeur-driven luxurious Mercedes. Enjoy a 3 hours tour of Rome before getting to the hotel. The service is available from 7am to 9pm. After collecting the luggages, pass through the sliding glass door. The customer will find the driver at the arrival terminal.

data.name: Rome to Ladispoli Round-Trip Private Transfer
data.description: Enjoy a stress-free round-trip transfer between Rome and Ladispoli with our private service. Your professional English-speaking driver will meet you with a name sign, assist with your luggage, and ensure a comfortable ride in a clean, fully equipped vehicle. Relax with door-to-door service, child seats on request, and free Wi-Fi during your trip.

data.name: Fiat 500 vintage Tour in Rome VIP
data.description: This is a tour for clients who like to meet a true local, professional escort who knows how to engage the client and who makes their experience an unforgettable one. The vintage 500 an icon around the world. Join one of our rallies in the streets of Rome!!! Fiat 500 vintage ''dream's road''

data.name: Hidden Gems & Rome Catacomb Tour Small Group 8 People Max.
data.description: This tour is designed for those who want to enjoy a different Rome, far from the hectic atmosphere of popular tourist sites, but still full of wonders, moving between sites in a comfortable and air-conditioned van with a small group of 8 people or less, so your experience is intimate and you will be guided by a local expert. Perhaps the most satisfying part of this car tour in Rome is the peace and tranquility that you will find in so many places and the awareness that you are travelling further and seeing more than the average visitor. So, if you want to see the "real Rome" and its true off-road gems, in comfort and with a local, take a ride with us! We would like to share our city with you, introducing you to Rome as a local.

data.name: Rome: Saint Peter's Basilica, Papal Tombs Small-Group Tour
data.description: St. Peter’s Basilica draws millions of visitors a year, but visiting this Catholic landmark without a guide means missing out on the significance of the artworks and papal tombs inside. Learn the stories behind masterpieces like Michelangelo’s *La Pietà” as you tour the lavishly gilded interior with a guide. Small-group experiences are capped at just 10 people for an intimate feel.

data.name: Best of Rome Walking Tour With Piazza Navona, Trevi Fountain
data.description:
Your walking tour starts at Piazza di Spagna, one of the city’s most popular squares, known for its setting at the bottom of the Spanish Steps. Walk up these famous steps to enjoy a lovely view from the top, and then continue along Rome’s winding cobblestone alleys to the Trevi Fountain.

Stop at the fountain to post for photos and throw a coin in the water, if you wish, which legend says ensures your return to Rome someday. Then continue to the square that Romans consider to be the center of the city, Piazza Colonna, home to a column erected by Marcus Aurelius. Make your way to the Pantheon, a stately temple known for its concrete dome and open oculus, before heading to Piazza Navona, one of Rome’s liveliest squares, where street artists show off their talents and visitors mingle around Bernini’s Fountain of the Four Rivers.

data.name: Rome Early Morning Piazzas Sightseeing Tour With Breakfast
data.description: Spend your morning relaxed and watch Rome wake up during this early sightseeing tour of Rome’s Piazzas. You’ll meet your guide for a leisurely Italian breakfast, including a cappuccino. Then, as you start to perk up, tour the piazzas around Four Lions Fountain. Walk alongside your guide as you visit Piazza del Popolo, the Trevi Fountain, Piazza Navona, and Piazza di Spagna. Learn about the history of each Piazza before they become crowded with visitors and locals.

data.name: Rome Evening Sightseeing Small-Group Walking Tour
data.description: Many of Rome’s most popular tourist attractions take on a new life in the evening, lit up beneath the night sky. On this small-group walking tour experience the Spanish Steps, Trevi Fountain, the Pantheon, and much more by a different light, while hearing hearing each stop’s unique history and cultural legacy.

data.name: Roman Pasta & Tiramisu Class in Vatican Area
data.description:
Step into a home kitchen near Vatican City and begin your experience with wine and a seasonal bruschetta featuring mozzarella, tomatoes and local ingredients. Then, under your pasta chef’s guidance, mix, roll and shape fresh dough into fettuccine and ravioli, learning heritage techniques along the way.

Top your pasta with a rich ragù sauce before turning your attention to dessert. Prepare a layered tiramisù with espresso and mascarpone, then sit down with your small group to enjoy your creations. Finish the meal with coffee and liqueur and leave with cherished recipes from your Roman culinary adventure.

data.name: Ancient Appia and Roman Catacombs Private Tour with Golf Cart
data.description:
Explore Rome on an exclusive golf cart with pick-up from your hotel. Discover the city's lesser-travelled places, starting with the Cestia Pyramid and the historic Via Appia Antica, walking on the original pavement. Admire the Baths of Caracalla and live a unique experience in the Catacombs, where you will spend 30 minutes with a group and an official guide of the catacombs. Visit Cecilia Metella's Mausoleum, Maxentius' Villa and the Church of Domine Quo Vadis, far from the most common tourist routes. You will finish with Porta San Sebastiano, one of the most iconic gates of the Aurelian walls. Your expert guide will accompany you at every stage, telling you fascinating stories. A private tour to discover an authentic and quiet Rome.

What is included:

Pick-up and drop-off from your hotel.

Private golf cart tour with guide.

30 minutes in the catacombs with official guide.

data.name: St. Peter's Basilica and Tombs of the Popes Private Tour
data.description: St. Peter’s Basilica is one of the top sights in Rome—with the crowds you’d expect from such a masterpiece of Renaissance architecture. Get priority access during this private express tour, which includes a visit to the panoramic dome. Begin with a stroll through St. Peter’s Square, then follow your guide inside to tour the ground-floor church and underground tombs.

data.name: Frascati Private Day Trip to Vineyards From Rome
data.description: Ignite your inner wine connoisseur and explore the ethereal beauty of Frascati on this private day trip from Rome. Discover centuries-old stories lingering amidst picturesque squares, churches, and villas. Tour a venerable winery with its vineyards and cellars before indulging in an exquisite cheese and wine pairing experience. Blissful aromas wafting through sunlit air as you discover timeless flavors indigenous to Italy's landscape. Upgrade to enjoy lunch at a traditional family restaurant.

data.name: From Rome to Florence 1-day tour by train with Uffizi Gallery tickets
data.description: Experience the beauty of Florence, the capital city of Tuscany and the birthplace of Renaissance, in less than two hours by high-speed train from Rome.You'll first meet with your tour leader just outside the Roma Termini railway station to be checked in and board the train. Upon arrival in Florence, a local guide will meet you in Piazza del Duomo and take you on a walking tour of the city, including the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, Ponte Vecchio and Piazza della Signoria. You'll then be provided with skip-the-line access to the famous Uffizi Gallery, where you'll be able to admire the masterpieces of Botticelli, Michelangelo, Raphael, and more, as your local guide unveils the secrets and stories behind these priceless works of art.At the end of the visit, you'll have plenty of free time to explore the city at your leisure and enjoy lunch or a snack (not included in the price) at a nice restaurant or bar. Finally, you'll meet at a designated time and head to the train station to travel back to Rome in the late afternoon. Don't miss this opportunity to immerse yourself in the rich history and art of Florence.

data.name: VIP Private Tour Vatican Rome
data.description: Enjoy a personalized journey through the Vatican Museums unique perspective view with a PRIVATE Group Tour led by an official Vatican City Guide. Skip the long lines and dive straight into the rich history and stunning art collections housed within the Vatican. Marvel at the Sistine Chapel’s breathtaking frescoes by Michelangelo, stroll through the Gallery of Maps, and discover hidden gems and fascinating stories brought to life by your expert guide. Perfect for art enthusiasts and history lovers seeking a more intimate, in-depth experience. Book now for a VIP visit to one of the world's most iconic cultural sites!

data.name: Private Cruise with Yacht on the Tiber and Aperitif on Board
data.description: Why choose our tour aboard the beautiful Stradivaria yacht? We offer the opportunity to experience an unforgettable atmosphere along the Tiber River, the foundations of ancient Roman history, enjoying an exceptional view of some of the city's most important monuments while enjoying a delicious aperitif including drinks and snacks on board. data.name: Agricultural Brewery Tour in the Roman Countryside
data.description:
Through this visit to the brewery you will be able to live a unique experience along the entire production chain that brings beer from the earth to the glass.

In fact, we will visit the barley and hops plantations, and then move inside the brewery where all the steps from cooking to bottling will be described accurately, all accompanied by the tasting of our beers.

data.name: Regina Ciclarum: from Rome to the sea along the sacred river
data.description: From the city to the countryside, reaching the sea. A riding through history and nature. Bridges, ancient ruins, industrial archeology and castles will be the backdrop for this beautiful tour. Imagine being able to dive into the sea of Rome. With the Regina Ciclarum all this is possible, you will cross 40km of cycle path and dirt roads starting from the center of Rome, skirting the Tiber until reaching Fiumicino, where a well-deserved swim in the sea and a tasty Cartoccio of Calamari and Prawns will await you before take the return train that will take you to San Pietro, and then head to the starting point. ATTENTION: Not Recommended for Children. Recommended for people with a minimum of training.Food and drinks are not included in the price to leave you more freedom in choosing what (and how much) you want to eat.

data.name: Castel Sant'Angelo: Hosted Priority Entry Ticket
data.shortDescription: Get a glimpse into Roman history at this former fortress by the Tiber River
data.description:
Discover Castel Sant'Angelo, a museum on the right bank of the Tiber River. Originally a grand tomb, the Castel Sant'Angelo has served as a medieval fortress and a defense against invasions. 

Explore five floors, go through former Papal residence rooms, and see the chamber of ashes. Here you'll see frescoes and the remains of notable Roman figures.

The visit ends on the castle's roof terrace, with stunning views of Rome, including the Vatican City, the Tiber River, and the Bridge of Angels.

data.name: Opera Serenades at The Princess secret apartment, Palazzo Doria Pamphilj
data.description: Explore the concealed wonders within the Secret Apartment of Princess Doria Pamphilj, a treasury of art and history, exclusively unveiled for a privileged few. Immerse yourself in a serenade accompanied by world-class voices resonating through rooms steeped in nobility and adorned with masterpieces. Every note weaves into the historical tapestry of this space, where classical furnishings and opulent artworks collectively echo a splendid era long past. Within the very halls that the Doria Pamphilj family has graced for centuries, partake in a concert that pays homage to this legacy. Each carefully chosen piece mirrors the architectural and artistic marvels enveloping you, delivering an educational and enchanting performance. Our curated repertoire guides guests on an auditory journey through Italy’s musical heritage, resonating with the essence of the nation's rich history. Led by a sublime soprano, whose voice captivates like the narratives within each aria, the performance is enhanced by the melodic whispers of a transverse flute and the resonant strumming of a baroque guitar. The theorbo's deep, sonorous plucks add a layer of baroque richness, crafting a multi-sensory tribute to Italy’s musical masters. With exclusivity as our signature, attendance is intentionally limited, fostering a personal connection to both the music and the majestic surroundings. Secure your tickets now and be among the select few to revel in opera within the private chambers of Princess Doria Pamphilj. It transcends mere performance it becomes a cherished memory of your Roman holiday, an extraordinary event beyond the ordinary. data.name: Private Tour of Colosseum Arena Floor & Ancient Rome
data.description: This private Colosseum tour offers a unique and immersive experience, allowing visitors to step back in time and explore the ancient structure up close. The tour includes a private guided walk on the reconstructed Arena Floor, where gladiators once fought, as well as visits to the Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, all led by a professional English-speaking guide. By entering the Arena Floor through the "Gate of Death", visitors can relive the history of the Colosseum and imagine the fierce battles that took place, making for an unforgettable and exclusive experience that few Colosseum visitors get to enjoy.

data.name: Venice Day Trip by Train from Rome - Private Tour
data.description: After a 3.5-hours high-speed train journey, you will be captivated  by the beauty of Venice, made up of 117 small islands connected to each other by 400 bridges.  Let yourself be seduced by one of the city considered among the most beautiful in the world  and, together with its lagoon, it is a World Heritage Site by UNESCO. Your assistant will guide you to explore the loveliest corners of this extraordinary city, built upon wooden pilings, from Saint Mark's Square to the Doge’s Palace, including the bell tower and the famous Grand Canal. Let yourself be surprised by the many treasures hidden in the narrow streets of Venice and its enchanting canals. Lose yourself in an unforgettable experience. Departure train (suggested): Rome - Venice 06.35. Arrival at 10.34 Venice - Rome 16.22. Arrival at 20.00

data.name: Enjoy an Authentic Ancient Roman Dinner!
data.description:
Join the latest culinary trend of immersive and social dining where local hosts invite you into their homes for a magical meal.

Having managed for more than 35 years the bistro “Creperie of Testaccio”, a well-known bistro/restaurant specialised in crepes and galettes, I gained a great knowledge of international cuisine, the ancient Roman cuisine and of the vegan and vegetarian cuisine. I always mantained a great interest in the recovery of the traditional Mediterranean recipies, in the value of cuisine as a means for nourishing the soul and the psychophysical well-being of my guests. For this reason in my career, I have prioritized the “seasonability” and the “emotional value “of food. The ancient Roman dinner will be held in an elegant apartment located just a few steps from the Colosseum following the ancient Roman receips of Marcus Gavius Apicius, gastronome, cook and Roman writer who lived at the turn of the first and second century A.D. He wrote the oldest Roman cookery receips book “ The res coquinaria” . In the res coquinaria are described dishes that served to make the banquests of Roman nobles and aristocrats unique and special for showing their power and magnificence on the other foreign guests. During the ancient Roman dinner will be described dishes and the ancient Roman techniques of their preparation. Will follow the reading of the classic texts of the ancient Roman cuisine such as the famed the dinner of “Trimalchone” narrated in the Satyricon of Petronio and the famous lustful Lucullian dinner narrated by Plutarch interpreted by our expert archaeology lecturer Claudia Pinci accompained by the sound of the traditional ancient roman music .

data.name: 1-Day Rome: Vatican & Colosseum Tour
data.description: Embark on a journey where ancient history and Renaissance beauty blend seamlessly under the Eternal City sky. Your day begins with the awe-inspiring Vatican Museums! As you step into the realm of divine art at the Vatican Museums, behold Michelangelo's masterpieces in the Sistine Chapel, and marvel at the majesty of St. Peter’s Square embracing you. Just follow the instructions in the voucher to reach out to your guide and the rest of the group at the meeting point! After the morning portion of the tour, you’ll enjoy some free time to have lunch at your leisure (meal not included in the package), to later meet with your tour leader to leave with the rest of your group and enjoy the afternoon venue you’ll be visiting: the Colosseum. This is where gladiators once battled, surrounded by the ruins of the Roman Forum and the regal Palatine Hill, offering a glimpse into Rome's glorious past. This tour promises a comprehensive experience of Rome’s heart and soul, meticulously designed for those who seek depth and connection with the Eternal City. Disclaimer: Please note that during the Jubilee Year, some areas of the Vatican Museums or the Sistine Chapel may be inaccessible due to religious ceremonies beyond our control. Thank you for understanding. Disclaimer: Please note that if the Sistine Chapel is not accessible for reasons beyond our control, no partial refund will be provided

data.name: Private Tour Discovering Rome
data.description: Enjoy a relaxing panoramic tour of Rome by private car or minivan and discover the magical charm of the most famous monuments illuminated when the sun goes down. It’s a special way to see these important places under another light. Get on board with us! Enjoy a relaxing panoramic tour of Rome by private car or minivan and discover the magical charm of the most famous monuments illuminated with the enchanting sunset lights. It’s a special sight to see these important monuments under another light. You will walk across the ex Jewish Ghetto, a traditional historic neighborhood. In the heart of the ex ghetto (Piazza Mattei) one of the cutest fountains in town stands out, the Fontana delle Tartarughe. The Jewish Ghetto of Rome is the second most ancient ghetto in Italy after the one in Venice, and it can be considered the heart and soul of Roman cuisine. You will walk into Piazza della Rotonda and enjoy a lit Pantheon, a Roman temple to all the gods wanted by M. Agrippa which was later converted into a church: this is the only ancient Roman temple that remained untouched throughout the centuries, and it’s stunning to see at night when the crowds are away. Next stop is… Just close your eyes and throw a coin over your right shoulder straight into the Trevi Fountain: it’s said that those who do so, are granted to come back to Rome someday. Your walk continues towards Piazza di Spagna, one of the city’s most popular squares, known for its setting at the bottom of the Spanish Steps. Walk up these famous steps to enjoy a lovely view from the top (or Trinità dei Monti). This is an itinerary suggestion. Customers can decide the best itinerary according to their needs and discuss it with their guide. The tour will last 3 hours approximately. Entrances are not included.

data.name: Explore Gourmet Rome: Private experience in Michelin Restaurants
data.description: Are you a Master chef? Then this is what you are looking for! In this unique experience you will savor 4 starred dishes in 3 different premium restaurants. Our expert foodie will guide you thru a proper sensorineural experience in a Michelin awarded atmosphere. Are your tastebuds ready for it? Private tour with transportation included

data.name: Oratorio Del Gonfalone: Sounds of Love and Spain
data.description: Immerse yourself in an unforgettable evening at the historic Oratorio del Gonfalone with 'Sounds of Love and Spain'. This musical journey will captivate your senses, transporting you through enchanting melodies and rich cultural heritage. Celebrate the 400th anniversary of Robert Dowland's works with evocative pieces such as 'Come Again, Sweet Love Doth Now' and 'Flow my Tears'. The program also features exquisite compositions like 'Triste Estaba El Rey David', 'Por Asperos Caminos', and 'Si me Llaman' by Alonso Mudarra, offering a glimpse into the heart of Spanish renaissance music. Adding to this cultural tapestry are Manuel de Falla's 'Siete Canciones Populares Españolas', marking the 150th anniversary of his birth with delightful adaptations of Spanish folk songs like 'El Paño Muruno' and 'Seguidilla Murciana'.

data.name: Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel skip-the-line ticket
data.description: Purchase a skip-the-line ticket, and avoid long queues. You'll be greeted by friendly staff, who are more than willing to provide all the necessary information for a well-organised visit. They will escort you to the entrance, guide you through security checks, and then you're free to explore.Prepare to be captivated by the splendour of one of the world's most significant museums: the Vatican Museums. Step into the Sistine Chapel and submerge yourself in an awe-inspiring and unforgettable experience. Encounter a wealth of art and history as you traverse locations graced by renowned names. Michelangelo in the Sistine Chapel, Raphael in the Rooms, Caravaggio and Leonardo in the Pinacoteca, Laocoön in the Octagonal Courtyard, along with the Gallery of Geographical Maps, the Etruscans, and the Egyptians under the name of Gregory XVI. Admire an extensive collection as you meander through courtyards and navigate the lengthy corridors linking one room to another. All these treasures have been preserved, constructed, and collected to enhance the grandeur of a city that already sparkles on its own.With your skip-the-line tickets, gain direct access to the Museum and delve into the narratives of the illustrious individuals who once roamed these corridors before you - artists, popes, poets, painters, and many more. Explore at your leisure without wasting precious time.

data.name: Small-Group Vatican & Sistine Chapel Guided Tour
data.description: Explore the Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter’s Square with an Expert Guide – Small Group Tour Tour Overview Step into the artistic and spiritual heart of Vatican City on this top-rated small-group guided tour (max 10 guests). data.name: Capri Island at your pace from Rome!
data.description: Join us on this classic journey, departing from Rome to explore the beauty of southern Italy. Capri From Rome We will begin our journey travelling south on the “highway of the sun”, passing by the famous Roman countryside, Castelli Romani. Our first short stop is in Naples, a world-renowned city home to incredible views of the Mediterranean, Mount Vesuvius, and countless historic sites. Take the ferry for a nice 1 hour (approx) sailing trip to Capri. Discovery the charming beauty of Capri with our enthusiastic tour guide. Explore the famous alleys, the Piazzetta and the countless charms that have made Capri a favorite destination. data.name: Amatriciana  & Tiramisù Cooking Class and Dinner in Monteverde
data.description:
What better way to explore a city than by discovering its cuisine first hand? Put on a chef's hat for the day and learn how to make classic dishes, local specialties and impressive plates with our expert hosts. Sign up for one of our fun, immersive cooking classes and discover a new hidden talent!

Start the cooking class by preparing Tiramisu, followed by pasta from scratch with Amatriciana sauce. Enjoy nibbles while you cook, then sit down for dinner with a view! • Snack on welcome Bruschetta during the class, then sit down to enjoy your pasta for dinner • Wine is included • Massimo's home is in Monteverde Vecchio, just a few minutes from Trastevere and the historic center • Communal cooking class and dining for up to 12 people • Massimo has a wonderful sense of hospitality and a great love for Italian food About your host, Massimo: "I'll host you in our stunning house near the Gianicolo hill, a unique location in a famous and historic neighborhood, with breathtaking views of Rome. My large and elegant living room is perfect for social eating."

data.name: Colonna Gallery Entrance Tickets
data.shortDescription:
A true jewel of the Roman Baroque, the Galleria Colonna was commissioned in the mid 1600s by Cardinal Girolamo I Colonna and his nephew Lorenzo Onofrio Colonna. It was inaugurated by Lorenzo Onofrio’s son, Philip II, in 1700. The original project is by the architect Antonio del Grande; it was then integrated by Gian Lorenzo Bernini, Paolo Schor and Carlo Fontana in the last decade of the 1600s.

From the very beginning, the Gallery was conceived as a large boardroom, which was to celebrate the victory of the Christian fleet over the Turks at the Battle of Lepanto in 1571. The commander of the Papal fleet, Marcantonio II Colonna, is depicted numerous times throughout the vault of the Great Hall of the Gallery and in the Room of the Battle Column.

The Gallery includes works by Lorenzo Monaco, Domenico Ghirlandaio, Palma the Elder, Salviati, Bronzino, Tintoretto, Pietro da Cortona, Annibale Carracci (painting of The Beaneater), Guercino, Francesco Albani, Muziano and Guido Reni. Ceiling frescoes by Filippo Gherardi, Giovanni Coli, Sebastiano Ricci, and Giuseppe Bartolomeo Chiari celebrate the role of Marcantonio II Colonna in the battle of Lepanto (1571).

data.name: The Colonna Palace Walking Tour
data.description: The construction of the various wings of Palazzo Colonna lasted for five centuries and this led to the overlap of different architectural styles, both exterior and interior, that characterize it and reflect the different epochs of belonging. From 1300 to 1500 it presented itself as a real family fortress. Oddone Colonna, elected pope on 11 November 1417 and assumed the name of Martin V, destines the Palace to the Pontifical See and lives there from 1420 to 1431, the year of his death. In the austere halls of Palazzo Colonna, Pope Martino V plans and realizes in ten years a great plan of cultural, urban and administrative renaissance of the city of Rome, which lay in ruinous condition after the tormented period of the captivity of Avignon and of the Western schism. In 1527, during the sack of Rome by the troops of the Emperor Carlo V, Palazzo Colonna is one of the few buildings that are not burnt thanks to the good relations of the family with the Empire...

data.name: Roman Dinner Filled with Wine
data.description:
Join the latest culinary trend of immersive and social dining where local hosts invite you into their homes for a magical meal.

Massimo welcomes you for a dinner in his home in the beautiful Roman neighborhood of Monteverde. You’ll experience Massimo’s excellent hospitality as you are served an incredible 4-course dinner, complete with Roman specialties. Sip away on complementary Prosecco, digestifs and excellent Italian wines and really get to know your host as Massimo shares his passion for cooking with you!

data.name: Pasta-making class, wine tasting and dinner in Frascati
data.description: Enjoy a 2.5-hour enogastronomic experience in Frascati, where quality wines are produced since the 15th century! Meet your group and your guide outside the city's railway station and begin your tour with a walk among the quaint alleys and picturesque corners of Frascati. Reach your host's old cellar where you will find out more about the area's wine production. Then, with the support of an expert chef, you will prepare homemade pasta and Roman style sauces like Carbonara, Amatriciana, and Cacio e Pepe. Relax and enjoy your own pasta while tasting the family’s wines Frascati Superiore DOCG and Vagnolo before concluding your experience with a visit to the cave below the cellar.

data.name: BASILICA |Vatican Museums Sistine Chapel: Skip-The-Line Guided Tour (Russian Language)
data.shortDescription:
Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel: Saints Tour has prepared for you a unique and unforgettable experience. The present tour includes:

  • privileged entrance to the Vatican Museums
  • guided tour of the Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel

You will have at your complete disposal one of our specialized and accredited by the Vatican guides. The route of this guided tour has been designed to let you discover – in approximately two and a half hours, with the assistance of a skilled tour guide trained in art history – unique masterpieces without wasting time in long queues.


TICKET INFO

Free: from 0-5 years old;
Reduced: 6 to 18 years old;
Students (reduced): from 19-25 years old. This offer is valid only upon presentation of a valid student card, to be shown at the time of entry and/or check-in.

 

Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel: what awaits you


With this guided tour, you will be able to admire some of the most famous works of art renown all over the world: we are offering a journey into time and space, into history and culture, but, most of all, a fast-starting journey, where no exhausting waits in queue are involved.

Our groups are made up by a maximum of 30 people and are all accompanied by certified Vatican tour guides, who will take you through the priceless artistic treasures enshrined in the seven different museums that make up the very heart of the Vatican Museum complex.
In a relaxed and informal atmosphere, your guide will tell you stories and curiosities that will help
you to understand the historical, artistic and cultural context that has molded the masterpieces hosted in the Hall of the Muses, in the Pio-Clementine Museum, in the Gallery of Maps, in the Gallery of Tapestries, in the Raphael Rooms and in the magnificent Courtyard of the Pinecone that opens in the heart of Vatican City.

The tour of the Vatican Museums will culminate with the visit to the Sistine Chapel; since it is forbidden to speak aloud inside, your guide will deliver explanations and directions outside, using the special panels provided by the Museums. Once inside, you can admire the paintings that truly represent the highest peak of Italian Renaissance art, from the precious frescoes by Botticelli, Perugino, Pinturicchio, Ghirlandaio, Luca Signorelli and Piero di Cosimo, to the extraordinary vault cycle and the Last Judgement by Michelangelo.

At the end of this incredible experience, your guide will briefly tell you about the history of the Vatican and the majestic St Peter’s Basilica.

SOME CURIOSITIES

  • The Vatican Museums were established by Pope Julius II in 1506 from a single statue, the marble group of Laocoon.
  • The Gallery of Maps, 120 meters long, ideally reproduces the line of the Apennines: on the left, there are the regions facing the Tyrrhenian Sea, and on the right those facing the Adriatic Sea.
  • In the Stanza della Segnatura, the philosophers who crowd the School of Athens painted by Raphael, have the features of his fellow painters: Bramante is the mathematician Euclid, Plato displays Leonardo’s hieratic face, Heraclitus borrows the frowning expression of Michelangelo, whose shady character was universally known. In the foreground, Buonarroti’s infamous boots, which he did not take off even to go to bed.
  • A self-portrait of Michelangelo can be found in the Sistine Chapel  more precisely, in the Last Judgment: Buonarroti reproduced his features in the skin that St. Bartholomew holds in his hands.
  • All the conclaves that precede the papal elections, take place today in the Sistine Chapel.

data.name: Rome: City Center Guided Private Tour With Dinner
data.description: While there are many famous landmarks to intrigue curious travelers in Rome, the Italian capital is also home to many hidden gems that most tourists miss. On this private guided tour, explore popular sites such as the Spanish Steps and the Trevi Fountain while also discovering a a few local secrets before finishing your trip with dinner at a local restaurant.

data.name: Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel Guided Tour
data.description: If you are planning to visit Rome, you can't miss the wonders of the Vatican. Get ready to admire the beauty of a unique complex in the world. Before starting the tour, feel the imposing atmosphere of this incredible place.With a professional guide and priority access, you will discover the masterpieces that make up the Vatican Museums. The experience cannot end without one of the most important icons of Rome, Italy, and the world... the unique Sistine Chapel, with frescoes made by Michelangelo.Don't miss the unique opportunity to discover the gems of the Vatican. A guided tour that is not just passing through or getting to know. It is an experience, a memory, and a delight.

data.name: Rome Half-Day Self-Guided Outdoor Escape Adventure
data.description: The historic, storied streets of Rome make it a great spot for a mysterious adventure. Explore the city while trying to gather clues and solve puzzles on this half-day self-guided outdoor escape room adventure delivered straight to your mobile phone. Uncover an intriguing tale set in Rome’s haunting past and do your best to unravel the mystery before it’s too late.

data.name: Rome Sightseeing Walking Tour and Ice Cream
data.description: Are you looking for a sightseeing tour in Rome that includes the best places to visit? There is much to see and do, from ancient Roman remains to romantic fountains and magnificent churches. Discover the most Beautiful Fountains and Squares in 3 hours, tasting delicious ice cream! Following your private guide in this experience, you will enjoy all the must-sees, saving time for other activities.

data.name: Vatican City St. Peter's Basilica Tour with Art Historian
data.description: It’s one thing experiencing St. Peter's Basilica with a guide—it’s another experiencing it with a professional art historian. That’s exactly what you’ll do on this tour, embarking on a deep journey through one of Europe’s finest sites. You’ll see the famous basilica, the inside of the dome, the Vatican crypts, and so much more, walking your way through 500+ years of Italian art and history.

data.name: Lezione di cucina- piazza di spagna-pasta&tiramisu
data.description: Our chefs will guide you step by step in an experience to discover Roman flavours. Together I will prepare a complete meal from start to finish. The menu? The most famous dish in the world! The fettuccine and also the tiramisu You will taste the goodness of Italian cuisine made by you together with us Obviously a good glass of wine cannot be missing to accompany everything, like true Italians. Have fun being a chef for a day!

data.name: Rome: Vatican & Colosseum Small-Group, Full-Day Tour
data.description: Discover the most famous landmarks in Rome and the Vatican City—all in the space of a single day—on this in-depth, small-group tour. Explore the Colosseum, the Roman Forum, Vatican Museums, and Sistine Chapel—all with the insight and personal attention of a guide exclusive to you and your group. Handy audio headsets ensure you don’t miss a word of the tour, plus, prebooked entry makes the whole day hassle-free.

data.name: Rome Squares Guided Small-Group Walking Tour
data.description: Discover the magic of Rome's piazzas with this small-group squares of Rome walking tour. Wander through breathtaking piazzas like Piazza del Popolo and Piazza Augusto Imperatore, as your guide shares rich, engaging stories behind the city's most iconic landmarks. With every step, you'll uncover layers of Roman history and elegance without the hassle of planning a single detail.

data.name: Afterlight Food Tour in the Soul of Rome
data.description:
Just like its history, Roman cuisine is vast and varied. Discovery Tours is proud to offer you this fantastic typical Roman food tour. Italian cuisine is usually characterized by its simplicity, with many dishes having only two to four main ingredients. This tour will give you an ultimate experience to emerge into the culture of authentic local lifestyle and cuisine.

Our guide will take you to various places to sample different food. Have a taste of amazing pasta, pizza, traditional cheeses, and a variety of cured meats. This food tour is guaranteed to leave you satisfied.

Important: Let us know if you have any allergies and dietary restrictions.

data.name: Private Vatican City Food and Wine Tour
data.description: Taste your way around Vatican City for a sightseeing tour with a difference. The perfect treat for groups of food-loving families and friends, this private experience includes visits to the bars and restaurants of Vatican City where traditional evening drinks, regional treats, and street food await. The must-see Vatican sights are included on the route, too, and you’ll learn about them from a private guide.

data.name: Renaissance and Baroque private walking tour in Rome's city center
data.description: Rome is a city in which archaeology, history and art symbiotically live. Walk through the historic center of Rome with your private tour guide to visit a real open-air museum!On your tour you'll learn about the most important monuments of the Baroque and Renaissance periods. You will have the opportunity to admire the famous Piazza di Spagna, the Trevi Fountain, the palaces of power and the monuments symbolizing the unity of the nation. Visit the Church of Sant’Ignazio admire its frescoes, see the Pantheon and many other monuments that are symbols of the Eternal City.

data.name: Skip-the-Line Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel Private Tour
data.description: Discover the Vatican museums on this 3 hours private tour. Navigate through the Vatican museums' rooms learn about the history of the Popes and their incredible collections of artworks with a professional guide. See the world famous Sistine Chapel and its incredible frescoes by Michelangelo. Step into Saint Peter's basilica directly from there, so avoid another line. Skip the line entrance is guaranteed in both Museums and Saint Peter's
